title: Network Security Engineer (SFTP)
description:
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Provide L2 support for Globalscape SFTP/MFT platforms, handling incidents, requests, and problem tickets
* Monitor SFTP services to ensure availability, performance, and SLA compliance
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to file transfers, connectivity, and user access
* Perform user provisioning, key management, and access control administration
* Coordinate with L3/engineering teams for escalations, root cause analysis, and major incidents
* Ensure adherence to security policies and compliance requirements (encryption, authentication, audit logs)
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and SOPs
* Support patching, upgrades, and configuration changes in SFTP/MFT environments
* Assist in onboarding new partners/clients and configuring file transfer workflows
* Participate in change management processes to ensure secure and controlled implementation
* Work location: IDFC Bank, Airoli, Navi Mumbai.
* Candidate will be employed by Commedia (third-party payroll) but stationed at client location. 24/7 rotational shift environment required.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Strong SFTP / MFT Profile with hands-on Globalscape EFT expertise and secure file-transfer troubleshooting
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have 4+ years of experience in Network Security / Secure File Transfer, with hands-on experience on Globalscape EFT (Enhanced File Transfer) MFT/SFTP platforms.
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must have experience providing L2 support for Globalscape SFTP/MFT (incidents, requests, problem tickets), monitoring services for availability, performance, and SLA compliance.
* Mandatory (Experience 3): Must have experience with user provisioning, key management, and access-control administration, and onboarding new partners/clients and configuring file-transfer workflows.
* Mandatory (Experience 4): Must have experience coordinating with L3/engineering for escalations, root-cause analysis, and major incidents, and supporting patching, upgrades, and configuration changes.
* Mandatory (Tech skill 1): Must have strong knowledge of SFTP, FTPS, SCP, and HTTPS file-transfer protocols, and key-based authentication (SSH keys, PGP encryption).
* Mandatory (Tech skill 2): Must have familiarity with firewalls, proxies, and network security fundamentals, with strong troubleshooting skills for connectivity, authentication, and transfer failures.
* Mandatory (Skill 1): Must have experience ensuring adherence to security policies and compliance (encryption, authentication, audit logs), and participating in change management for secure, controlled implementation.
* Mandatory (Skill 2): Must have an understanding of incident, change, and problem management (ITIL), and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and SOPs.
* Mandatory (Domain): Banking-industry experience preferred; strong candidates with the same technical experience from another industry are acceptable.
* Mandatory (Note): Must be comfortable with a 24/7 rotational shift environment at the client site (IDFC Bank, Airoli, Navi Mumbai)
* Mandatory (Communication): Must have good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Preferred (Skills): Automation/scripting (PowerShell, Python, or Bash); file-transfer integrations with enterprise applications (ERP, banking, trading); audit/compliance familiarity (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOX); exposure to other MFT platforms (Axway, TIBCO, IBM Sterling).

Experience: 4–6 years · Work from office · 6 days a week · Notice period up to 30 days

title: L2 Imperva DAM Security Engineer
description:
Job Description: L2 Security Engineer – Imperva DAM
  
  

* Location: Mumbai
* Employment Type: Full-Time
* Experience Level: Minimum 4 Years Exp.
* NOTE- MANDATORY IMPERVA EXPERIENCE AND IMMEDIATE TO 30 DAYS NOTICE PERIOD CANDIDATES WILL BE CONSIDERED

Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced L2 Security Engineer with
**specialized, hands-on expertise in Imperva Database Activity Monitoring (DAM) solutions**
. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, health monitoring, policy maintenance, alert handling, and troubleshooting of our enterprise DAM infrastructure. You will work closely with SOC, database, and infrastructure teams to safeguard critical data assets, analyze suspicious activities, and ensure robust regulatory compliance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure & Operations
  
  

* Monitor, administer, and maintain enterprise Imperva DAM infrastructure to ensure high availability and optimal performance.
* Configure, implement, and maintain DAM monitoring policies, rules, and exceptions.
* Oversee database activity tracking, privileged user actions, and access patterns using Imperva DAM.
* Support the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of DAM agents across diverse database environments.
* Proactively fine-tune DAM monitoring policies to reduce false positives and optimize security visibility.

Incident Management & Analysis
  
  

* Investigate database security alerts, anomalies, and potential security incidents in real-time derived from Imperva DAM.
* Collaborate with Security Operations Center (SOC) teams to support thorough incident analysis, containment, and remediation.
* Perform forensic analysis on database logs using Imperva reporting tools to identify root causes of security events.

Platform Support & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Diagnose and resolve DAM connectivity, agent communication, and monitoring impediments.
* Assist with software installations, routine system upgrades, and critical security patching for the Imperva environment.
* Monitor overall Imperva DAM server health, resource utilization, and operational performance.
* Execute system backup and disaster recovery restoration procedures for Imperva components as scheduled.
* Coordinate cross-functionally with database administrators (DBAs) and infrastructure teams to expedite issue resolution.

Compliance & Reporting
  
  

* Support continuous compliance monitoring frameworks leveraging Imperva compliance reports, including PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOX, and HIPAA.
* Generate structured operational, audit, and compliance reports from Imperva DAM for stakeholders and regulatory bodies.
* Ensure all database monitoring configurations strictly adhere to corporate and industry security policies.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience:

+ 4 to 6 years of total professional experience in cybersecurity or database security.
+ Mandatory: Minimum of 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in Imperva DAM administration and support.

* Core Technical Competencies:

+ Proven, hands-on operational experience with Imperva DAM solutions (Mandatory).
+ Strong foundation in database security monitoring concepts and threat vectors.
+ Demonstrated expertise in Imperva alert lifecycle management, policy tuning, and security event log analysis.
+ Working understanding of enterprise database platforms, including Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL, and PostgreSQL.
+ Functional proficiency in Windows and Linux operating system administration.
+ Experience with SIEM integration and centralized log analysis.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Imperva DAM Certification (Strongly Preferred)
* CompTIA Security+
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
* ITIL Foundation

Good-to-Haves
  
  

* Practical experience integrating Imperva logs with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, IBM QRadar, or Microsoft Sentinel.
* Basic scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Deep familiarity with global compliance frameworks, standard audit controls, and regulatory requirements.

Skills: compliance,infrastructure,database,database security,imperva

title: Workday Security Implementer / Administrator
description:
Job Description: Workday Security Implementer / Administrator
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**Workday Security Implementer / Administrator**
to lead, design, and manage our end-to-end Workday security architecture. In this role, you will define and own the overall security strategy, establish robust governance models, and ensure the Workday platform remains secure, compliant, and aligned with organizational needs. You will partner closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, Compliance, and Audit teams to deliver scalable, secure Workday solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Security Strategy & Governance**

* Define & Own Strategy: Establish and execute the overall Workday Security Strategy and governance framework to maintain platform-wide security integrity over time.
* Tenant Management: Lead tenant setup and execute large-scale, bulk security updates and reconfigurations as needed.
* Best Practices & Compliance: Provide expert guidance on Workday security best practices, system release management, and compliance standards.

**Core Security Administration & Maintenance**

* Configuration: Configure and maintain Workday security groups, domain security policies, and business process security policies (BPSPs).
* Role Architecture: Design and implement scalable role-based and user-based security models mapped directly to business requirements.
* Access Management: Oversee end-to-end user provisioning, deprovisioning, and role assignments across various functional areas.
* Auditing & Support: Perform regular security audits and access reviews. Troubleshoot and resolve complex security issues and access requests.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work as a key liaison with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, Internal Audit, and Compliance teams to translate complex business needs into secure technical implementations.

**Requirements & QualificationsExperience**

* Overall Experience: 5+ years of total professional experience.
* Domain Expertise: Minimum 5 years of relevant, hands-on experience in Workday security administration and implementation.

**Technical Skills & Competencies**

* Deep technical expertise in Workday security architecture, tenant setups, and bulk security updates.
* Strong understanding of Workday system release management and governance principles.
* Proven ability to design secure workflows across HR, Payroll, and Finance modules.

**Mandatory Certifications & Training**

* Required: Workday Pro Security Certification (or equivalent certification granting Implementer-level access in Workday).
* Required: Completion of official Workday Security Fundamentals training.
* Preferred: Workday HCM Certification (highly valued for supporting Core HCM functionality).

**Role & Requisition Details**

* Job Requisition Number: JR 1498662 / 900756
* Location: Pan India
* Vacancies: 1
* Interview Process: Client Interview Required

**The Work You'll Do**
At
**Sovos**

**Senior Network Operations Center Analyst**

* Escalate complex issues to senior engineers or supervisors as needed

* Serve as technical point of contact during critical incidents, providing updates to stakeholders
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and support teams to resolve complex issues
* Document technical issues, workarounds, and resolutions in knowledge management systems
* Identify patterns in escalated issues to recommend product improvements
* Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 coverage for critical issues

**What We Need From You**

* 3+ years of experience in network monitoring or support
* Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols
* Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to navigate complex technical systems
* Experience with monitoring tools and ticketing systems
* Strong analytical and communication skills
* Experience with incident management processes and tools
* Strong time management skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities simultaneously
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, 24/7 environment
* Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) for communication with customers and internal stakeholders

**What Does Sovos Offer You?**
The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
  
  

* Opportunity to work with a global organization and gain international exposure
* Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
* Mentoring Programs and career development opportunities
* Globally recognized Training and Development programs
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage
* Collaborative work environment with modern tools and technologies
* Opportunity to be part of a growing global team and shape its future

**Our Recruitment Process**
We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what a typical process will look like:
  
  
Stage 1: CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) and EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
  
  
Stage 2: Automated Video Interview
  
  
Stage 3: Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or key stakeholders
  
  
Stage 4: Final Interview
  
  
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
  
  
**Company Background**
Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.
  
  
More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries -- including half the Fortune 500 -- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

title: Assistant General Manager - Infra and IT - SCO
description:
**Job Description**
Key responsibilities
  
  
Linux Administration
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot RHEL and Oracle Linux servers.
* Manage Linux systems across physical, VMware and cloud environments, including users/groups, sudo, SSH, systemd, cron, DNS, NTP and network configuration.
* Administer file systems, LVM, NFS, SAN/NAS connectivity and multipathing; troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk I/O, kernel and network issues.
* Perform OS hardening, vulnerability remediation, package/repository management using YUM/DNF and capacity planning.
* Develop Bash/Shell automation for health checks, operational tasks and reporting.

Oracle Database Administration
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot Oracle databases, including supported enterprise versions such as 12c/19c and later.
* Manage instances, schemas, users, roles, privileges, tablespaces, listeners, initialization parameters and database storage.
* Monitor and tune SQL performance using AWR, ASH, ADDM, Explain Plan, SQL Trace, wait events, SGA/PGA and session analysis.
* Manage RMAN backup, restore and recovery, database cloning/refresh, migrations and point-in-time recovery.
* Configure and support Data Guard, replication, DR architectures, ASM and RAC environments where applicable.
* Plan and execute Oracle Release Updates/security patching and troubleshoot archive log, corruption, storage and recovery issues.

PostgreSQL Database Administration
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot PostgreSQL databases and clusters.
* Manage roles, privileges, schemas, tablespaces, extensions and configuration files including postgresql.conf and pg\_hba.conf.
* Tune queries, connections, memory, locks, transactions, indexes, checkpoints, autovacuum and database/storage growth.
* Manage pg\_dump/pg\_restore, pg\_basebackup, WAL archiving and Point-in-Time Recovery.
* Configure and support streaming replication and HA solutions such as Patroni, repmgr or equivalent where implemented.
* Perform major/minor upgrades, migrations, refreshes and troubleshoot replication lag, deadlocks, blocking and table/index bloat.

Microsoft SQL Server Administration
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade and troubleshoot Microsoft SQL Server databases.
* Manage databases, logins/users, permissions, database files, TempDB, SQL Agent jobs and maintenance activities.
* Configure and support Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, log shipping and replication where applicable.
* Manage full, differential and transaction-log backups and point-in-time recovery.
* Monitor and troubleshoot blocking, deadlocks, CPU/memory pressure, disk latency, waits and long-running queries.
* Perform query tuning, index/statistics management, SQL Server cumulative updates and integration with Active Directory authentication.

Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery
  
  

* Define and maintain database backup standards, retention, restore procedures and recovery runbooks.
* Coordinate with enterprise backup teams and regularly validate restore capability for Oracle, PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
* Participate in DR drills and validate RPO, RTO, replication status and application-consistent recovery.

Performance, Capacity & Availability
  
  

* Proactively monitor Linux and database performance across CPU, memory, disk, storage latency, network and SQL workloads.
* Perform capacity forecasting for database growth, tablespaces, file systems, transaction logs, WAL/archive logs and infrastructure resources.
* Work with application teams to optimize SQL and recommend scaling or configuration improvements.

Security, Compliance & Lifecycle
  
  

* Implement Linux/database hardening, least-privilege access, privileged/service account reviews and vulnerability remediation.
* Plan and execute Linux patching, Oracle Release Updates, PostgreSQL updates and SQL Server Cumulative Updates.
* Track end-of-support versions and develop upgrade/migration plans; support audit evidence and compliance closure.

Monitoring, Incident & Problem Management
  
  

* Configure proactive monitoring and alerts for availability, resource utilization, storage capacity, replication, backup failures, locks and database growth.
* Own troubleshooting of P1/P2 production incidents, perform RCA and drive corrective/preventive actions.
* Participate in on-call support for business-critical production systems.

Automation, Change & Documentation
  
  

* Automate repeatable activities using Bash/Shell, SQL, PL/SQL and PowerShell; Python/Ansible exposure is desirable.
* Follow ITIL change management, prepare implementation/rollback/validation plans and participate in CAB as required.
* Maintain server/database inventory, architecture/topology diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, backup/DR procedures, patch schedules and capacity reports.

**Qualifications & Competencies**
Skills and Competencies
  
  

* Strong hands-on Linux administration: RHEL / Oracle Linux, LVM, multipathing, NFS, SAN/NAS, systemd, SSH, TCP/IP, DNS, NTP and Shell scripting.
* Strong Oracle DBA skills: RMAN, Data Guard, AWR/ASH/ADDM, SQL tuning, patching, recovery, ASM; RAC knowledge preferred.

description:
**Join Our Internal Audit Team!**

We are expanding our team and looking for talented, motivated, and detail-oriented professionals to join our
**Internal Audit Department**
.

**Department:**
Internal Audit & Controls

**Qualification:**
CA/CIA/CMA/CISA/CFE

**1. Role Overview**

The role involves conducting risk-based internal audits, thematic audits, forensic reviews and technology-related audits across the organisation's business functions. The candidate should possess strong regulatory knowledge of the securities and capital markets industry, with in-depth understanding of retail broking operations, regulatory requirements and internal control frameworks.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

* **Thematic Audits:**
  Independently plan and execute thematic audits based on emerging risks, regulatory developments, business trends, control gaps and recurring audit observations.
* **Forensic Audits & Investigations:**
  Conduct preliminary investigations, transaction reviews, data analysis and forensic assessments relating to suspected fraud, employee misconduct, control circumvention, conflicts of interest and other irregularities.
* **Retail Broking Audits:**
  Conduct detailed audits of retail broking operations, including client onboarding, KYC, client funds and securities, RMS, dealing room operations, order execution, client complaints, surveillance, settlement and exchange-related compliance.
* **Business & Regulatory Audits:**
  Conduct audits across Institutional Broking, Investment Banking, Wealth Management, AIF, Internal Audit, PMS and other applicable business functions, considering their respective regulatory and operational requirements.
* **Systems & Cyber Audits:**
  Assess IT general controls, application controls, user access management, privileged access, change management, information security, cybersecurity and data protection controls.
* **ISO & Control Frameworks:**
  Evaluate adherence to applicable ISO standards, information security frameworks, documented policies, procedures and internal control requirements.
* **Regulatory Compliance:**
  Assess compliance with applicable SEBI regulations, stock exchange and depository requirements, circulars, internal policies and other relevant regulatory obligations.
* **Risk Assessment & Reporting:**
  Identify control weaknesses, assess inherent and residual risks, establish root causes and recommend practical corrective actions.
* **Audit Closure & ATR Monitoring:**
  Track audit observations, validate management action plans, monitor overdue items and assess the effectiveness of corrective actions.
* **Management Reporting:**
  Prepare audit reports, thematic review findings, risk summaries and presentations for senior management and relevant governance forums.
* **Data Analytics:**
  Use data-driven techniques to identify unusual transactions, patterns, exceptions and potential control failures.

**3. Mandatory Skills & Experience**

* Demonstrable experience in thematic audits —
  **mandatory**
  .
* Strong and in-depth knowledge of retail broking operations and the Indian securities market.
* Working knowledge of regulatory requirements applicable to retail and institutional broking, Investment Banking, Wealth Management, AIF and PMS.
* Experience in forensic audits, investigations, fraud risk assessment or transaction reviews.
* Exposure to system audits, cybersecurity reviews, IT general controls and application controls.
* Knowledge of ISO standards and information security/control frameworks.
* Strong analytical, documentation, report-writing and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to independently manage audits from planning and execution through reporting and closure.
* Proficiency in Excel and audit data analysis; experience with analytics or audit automation tools is an advantage.

**4. Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Candidates with experience in a stockbroker, securities firm, financial services organisation, Big Four or reputed risk advisory/internal audit firm will be preferred.
* Candidates should demonstrate professional scepticism, integrity, independence, sound judgement and the ability to challenge business practices constructively.

title: Data Privacy Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

**Larsen & Toubro Ltd, commonly known as L&T**
, is an Indian multinational conglomerate company, with business interests in engineering, construction, manufacturing, technology, information technology and financial services, headquartered in Mumbai.

The company is counted among world's top five construction companies.

The L&T Group comprises of 93 subsidiaries, 5 associate companies, 27 joint ventures and 35 jointly held operations, operating across basic and heavy engineering, construction, realty, manufacturing of capital goods, information technology, and financial services
**.**

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Waystone is a leading provider of institutional governance, administration, risk and compliance services to the asset management industry. With over 25 years’ experience, we support many of the world’s largest asset managers, providing a comprehensive range of specialist services from a global network of offices.
  
  
The Platform Engineering team builds and operates Waystone’s engineering platform, spanning cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, on-call and our internal developer portal. We provide the secure, automated foundations that the firm’s regulated services run on. We are looking for a Platform Engineer to help scale this platform through standardised, automated and compliant patterns, accelerating delivery for our development delivery teams while raising operational resilience across the estate.
  
  
We are a cross-skilled team by design: rather than narrow specialisation, we want every engineer able to work across the platform, giving us broader coverage, resilience and shared ownership.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Take ownership of larger, moderately complex pieces of platform work, setting objectives and delivering against project goals with a direct impact on team results.
* Design, implement and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure patterns and reusable Terraform modules across Azure, AWS and OCI, with a primary focus on Azure.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) libraries to ensure consistent, compliant and repeatable environments across all cloud providers.
* Build and support CI/CD and deployment automation using GitHub Actions, Octopus Deploy and ArgoCD, and configuration management using Ansible and Octopus Deploy.
* Support and enable development delivery teams – provisioning autonomous environments and reducing deployment friction while maintaining guardrails and separation of duties.
* Provide operational support for containerised and micro-service workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), maintaining high availability and reliability.
* Manage core infrastructure lifecycle tasks – vulnerability remediation and patching, upgrades, scaling and decommissioning across the Windows and Linux estate.
* Drive the adoption of cloud governance policies, security standards and architectural best practice, and help maintain continuous compliance evidence against the firm’s obligations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DORA).
* Contribute to observability and monitoring across the estate, and to incident response and on-call, including troubleshooting and root cause analysis that drives systemic improvement.
* Support disaster recovery testing to validate recovery plans and ensure rapid, reliable restoration of services.
* Identify and recommend improvements to systems, processes and infrastructure patterns to improve operational resilience, performance and cost efficiency.
* Explain and advocate technical approaches to development delivery teams and colleagues across IT, influencing platform practices and standards at an operational level.
* Provide guidance, code review and support to junior engineers, helping them develop across the platform.
* Document infrastructure blueprints, standards and standard operating procedures in Confluence and our internal Platform Portal to enable self-service.
* Participate in the on-call rota to support critical infrastructure services.

**Essential Knowledge & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (e.g. B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with a minimum of three years’ experience as a Platform Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, DevOps Engineer or similar role.
* Strong experience designing and implementing infrastructure in Azure and AWS.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
* Experience building and debugging CI/CD and deployment pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, Octopus Deploy, Azure DevOps or similar).
* Strong Windows OS management in cloud environments; solid Linux fundamentals (deeper experience a plus).
* Proficient in a scripting language such as PowerShell, with experience automating operational workflows.
* Sound understanding of cloud security principles, identity and access management (Entra ID / IAM) and network security.
* Understanding of application architectures and CI/CD workflows, and how infrastructure aligns with them.
* Experience working closely with development delivery teams in an agile environment, using tooling such as Jira and Confluence to manage and track work.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
* AI-literate, with the ability to adopt and apply AI-assisted engineering tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants and agents) to accelerate delivery, automation and documentation, and a willingness to keep pace with an evolving AI toolset.
* Able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams – balancing project delivery, BAU and support commitments – prioritising effectively and working independently across competing demands.
* Comfortable collaborating with UK-based colleagues across time zones as part of a global team.
* Able to participate in the on-call rota – on-call is a requirement of this role.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience operating in a regulated financial services or otherwise highly governed environment.
* Certification in Azure, AWS or DevOps practices.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (AKS), ArgoCD and containerised services.
* Experience with Ansible for configuration management and DR tooling.
* Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost-management best practice.
* Experience integrating AI or agentic tooling into engineering workflows (e.g. IaC generation, automated remediation, or documentation).
* Exposure to compliance-evidence or governance tooling and incident-management tooling.

Additional Information
  
  

* Participation in the on-call rota is a requirement of this role; standing on-call allowances apply.
* Opportunities for professional growth, including certifications in Azure, AWS and DevOps practices, within a deliberately cross-skilled team.
* You will join a global, collaborative team that values innovation, ownership and continuous learning, with a direct impact on the resilience of the firm’s platforms.

You shall also perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Security Consultant / Senior Security Consultant with expertise in penetration testing. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, web application, wireless, social engineering, physical penetration testing.
* Execute penetration testing projects using the established methodology, tools and rules of engagements.
* Execute red team assessments to highlight gaps impacting organizations security postures.
* Identify and exploit security vulnerabilities in a wide array of systems in a variety of situations.
* Perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
* Convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences including executives.
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 web and the ability to effectively communicate methodologies and techniques with development teams
* Understanding and experience with Active Directory attacks.
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Develop automated solutions that mitigate risks throughout the organization.
* Ability to automate DAST/SAST solutions and reporting
* Support SDLC and agile environments with application security testing and source code reviews.
* Provide technical leadership and advise to junior team members on attack and penetration test engagements.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of web-based application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).
* Good understanding of enterprise security controls in Active Directory / Windows environments
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Understanding of network security and popular attacks vectors.
* Ability to communicate detailed technical information to a non-technical audience clearly
* Experience with Operation Technology / Internet of Things, Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), Active Directory and 802.1x penetration testing
* Strong understanding of security principles, policies, and industry best practices
* Demonstrable flair for technical writing, including engagement reports, presentations and operating procedures

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* BE/ B.Tech/ MCA or equivalent
* Minimum of 3-4 years of work experience in penetration testing which may include at least three of the following: internet, intranet, web application penetration tests, wireless, social engineering, physical and Red Team assessments.
* One of the following certifications: OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, OSWE, CREST, CRTE, eCPTX, or eWPTX
* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems.
* 3-4 years of work experience in Strategy and Operations projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Certifications: CISSP, GPEN, GWAPT.

**What We Look For**

* Who can perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing and provide analysis for the testing results.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Cyber Consultant
description:
**Job Title:**
Cyber Consultant
  
  
**Base Location:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
**Experience:**
5+ years
  
  
**Region Covered:**
India, Middle East and South East Asia
  
  
**Job Purpose / Brief Of Job Role**
Serve as a technical expert supporting our underwriting teams and clients on risk assessment, incident response and other advisory services with the aim of enhancing the quality, resilience and scalability of our cyber business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct cyber risk assessments of individual commercial risks and translate technical findings into actionable underwriting recommendations.
* Identify, evaluate and benchmark the effectiveness of security controls against evolving threats, attack vectors and mitigation strategies.
* Continuously enhance our cyber risk assessment methodologies, frameworks and questionnaires.
* Provide analytical support on cyber coverage language and its alignment with current threat trends, loss scenarios and portfolio exposures.
* Deliver cyber security guidance, training and strategic advice to both internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Support incident response and claims teams with technical expertise, including incident analysis, post-incident reviews and the assessment of incident response service providers.
* Represent Munich Re at industry events and conferences; conduct trend scouting and publish topic papers on emerging threats and technologies.

**Education, Experience And Personal Attributes**

* Degree in IT Security, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant professional experience, complemented by relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor).

* Sound knowledge of major cyber risk frameworks (e.g. NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, ISO 27001) and of cyber and data protection regulation across India, the Middle East and Southeast Asia (e.g. CERT-In Directions, DPDP Act, IRDAI Cyber Security Guidelines, NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, MAS TRM).
* Ability to contextualise cyber threats by region and industry, factoring in geopolitical risk, regional regulation and local IT maturity.

title: Associate - Permanent Controller
description:
**Job Title:**
Permanent Controller
  
  
**Department**
: Cybersecurity and Digital Fraud
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
ITG is a Group function established in 2019 within ISPL, with a presence in Mumbai and Chennai. We collaborate with various business lines across the Group to provide IT services.
  
  
The position is part of Cybersecurity and Digital Fraud (CDF), the Group function responsible for cyber risk management, and more specifically the CISO Bureau supporting the Payments IT Risk Officer (ITRO) function.
  
  
The Payments ITRO team provides independent challenges and oversight within the first line of defense for the IT Payments Services perimeter. The team works with IT production, application, cybersecurity and governance stakeholders to ensure that ICT risks are understood, permanent controls are effectively executed, and remediation actions are completed on time.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The Operational Permanent Controller is responsible for executing and coordinating ICT permanent controls across the IT Payments Services perimeter. The role assesses the quality, completeness and traceability of control evidence, identifies control weaknesses, and follows remediation actions through closure.
  
  
This is a hands-on role combining control execution, analytical review and stakeholder coordination, with a direct contribution to the continuous improvement of the ICT control environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* ICT Permanent Control Execution
* Plan, organize and perform ICT permanent controls in line with the approved control plan,
* Collect and review supporting evidence from control owners and relevant IT stakeholders.
* Assess whether control objectives are met and whether evidence is complete, accurate, reliable and fully traceable.
* Record control results, findings and supporting evidence in the applicable Group GRC tools, including Risk360, where relevant.
* Ensure control execution is completed within agreed deadlines and proactively flag constraints or dependencies.
* Analysis of Results and Remediation Follow-up
* Analyze control results to identify weaknesses, recurring issues, potential risk exposure and opportunities to strengthen the control environment.
* Discuss findings constructively with control owners and subject-matter experts, ensuring that observations are factual, clearly documented and supported by evidence.
* Contribute to the definition of proportionate corrective actions, accountable owners and realistic target dates.
* Monitor remediation plans through closure, challenge overdue or insufficient actions and escalate material delays, blockers or residual risks when appropriate.
* Validate closure evidence in accordance with the applicable governance and documentation standards.
* Reporting, Governance and Stakeholder Coordination
* Contribute to the reporting on control execution, findings, remediation progress, overdue actions and key areas requiring management attention.
* Work closely with the Payments ITRO team, IT production and application teams, Cybersecurity, IT Governance, process owners and other control functions.
* Promote a consistent risk and control culture across the scope through day-to-day collaboration and constructive challenge.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Contribute to periodic reviews and continuous improvement of control procedures, testing approaches, evidence expectations and reporting templates.
* Participate in the identification of control gaps, duplication or opportunities for simplification and automation.
* Support awareness sessions and practical guidance for control owners on control execution and evidence quality.
* Contribute, when required, to broader IT operational risk activities such as risk assessments, issue follow-up and control framework reviews.
* Collaborate effectively across locations and time zones as a member of the extended Payments ITRO team.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Practical experience in operational permanent control, ICT risk management, internal control, technology risk or IT audit.
* Good understanding of control execution, control testing, evidence assessment, issue identification and remediation tracking.
* Good understanding of IT operations, application management, cybersecurity and IT service-management processes.
* Ability to translate control requirements into clear testing steps and evidence expectations.
* Experience with GRC or operational risk tools; knowledge of Risk360 and ServiceNow/GRC is an advantage.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for analysis, tracking and management reporting.

**Specific Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, or Risk Management or Audit, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in IT controls, technology risk, operational risk, internal control or IT audit.
* Experience working with cross-functional and international stakeholders is preferred.

**Behavioral Skills**
**Skills Referential**
**(**
**Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with the ability to distinguish material issues from minor exceptions.
* High attention to accuracy, evidence quality, traceability and documentation.
* Proactive, accountable and able to manage several controls and action plans in parallel.
* Confident in engaging multiple stakeholders and challenging constructively while maintaining collaborative relationships.
* Clear written and oral communication, including concise management reporting and meeting facilitation.
* Curious and improvement-oriented, with a practical problem-solving mindset.
* Team player who is comfortable working in a multicultural and geographically distributed organization.

**Education Level**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, or Risk Management or Audit, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in IT controls, technology risk, operational risk, internal control or IT audit.

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.
  
  
The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  
  
Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.
  
  
**What We Value**
We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.
  
  

* Seek Excellence.
* Be Selective To Be Effective.
* Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.
* Disagree Transparently.
* Encourage Independent Decision-Making.
* Build Dream Teams.

**Who You Are**
Galaxy is seeking a Senior Blockchain Security Engineer with expertise in securing smart contracts, blockchain protocols, and supporting applications and infrastructure. This is a hands-on individual contributor role based in India, with a strong focus on identifying and mitigating security risks across on-chain systems. The engineer will participate in assessments of blockchain architectures and smart contracts, followed by the facilitation and/or implementation of remediations. The engineer will work closely with Engineering, Product, Protocol, and Infrastructure teams to design and deliver secure software solutions at a rapid growth company.
  
  
**What You Do**

* Participate in secure software design, architecture, threat modeling, and code reviews for blockchain and on-chain systems.
* Perform security reviews and audits of smart contracts, including Solidity/EVM and Rust/Solana-based applications.
* Assist teams with the mitigation of findings by assessing impact, proposing solutions, and providing technical guidance for implementation.
* Assess blockchain-specific risks including smart contract vulnerabilities, protocol design flaws, and transaction security.
* Develop secure design patterns, reusable security controls, and tooling for blockchain applications and supporting infrastructure.
* Research emerging blockchain threats and mitigations, and leverage modern security and AI-assisted tooling to improve vulnerability discovery and code review.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 4+ years of experience in security engineering, product/application security, blockchain security, or software development of security features.
* Strong hands-on experience with blockchain technologies and smart contract security, including Solidity/EVM and/or Rust/Solana, secure coding, and in-depth code review.
* Strong hands-on experience with blockchain technologies and smart contract security, including Solidity/EVM and/or Rust/Solana, secure coding, and in-depth code review.
* Experience with secure SDLC practices and security testing techniques such as static analysis, dynamic analysis, software composition analysis, and fuzzing.
* Strong familiarity with several of the following topics: key management, authentication and authorization, TLS and PKI, cloud security, container and Kubernetes security, infrastructure security, and network security.
* Strong analysis skills, detail oriented, collaborative and solution-driven, with strong verbal and written communication skills.

**Bonus Points**

* Direct exposure to liquid staking, tokenized assets, or similar digital asset protocols and architectures.
* Published material on vulnerabilities/security bugs or meaningful security contributions within the Web3 community.
* Familiarity with DeFi protocol security, MPC, multi-signature systems, key management, and custody architectures.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
* Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees and their eligible dependents
* Free virtual coaching and counseling sessions
* Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry
* Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues
* Employee Resource Groups
* Benefits may vary depending on location.

description:

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Cloud Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll play a critical role in ensuring our clients' cloud infrastructure runs smoothly. You'll proactively monitor, identify, investigate, and resolve cloud-based incidents and service requests. Applying your technical expertise, you'll handle second-line support for incidents and requests with medium complexity, ensuring we meet our service level agreements (SLAs).
  
  
Your daily activities will include monitoring work queues, resolving incidents in a timely manner, and updating tickets with the tasks performed. You'll identify and analyze issues before they impact our clients, provide second-level support, and work closely with other teams and clients to extend necessary support. Your role is vital in executing changes with identified risks and mitigation plans, ensuring the smooth operation of our clients' cloud infrastructure.
  
  
You'll also be responsible for leading client escalations for operational issues, contributing to the change management process, and ensuring all changes have proper approvals. The successful candidate will contribute to and independently execute engagements involving:
  
  
**Cybersecurity Program Maturity Assessments**

* Assess governance structures, security operating models, policies, standards, and controls.

* Support development and implementation of privacy governance frameworks, policies, and operating procedures.

**AI Security & Governance**

* Assess AI systems for security, privacy, governance, and compliance risks.
* Support implementation of AI governance frameworks, risk management practices, and responsible AI controls.
* Evaluate controls related to GenAI solutions, model governance, data protection, and regulatory requirements.

**Security Awareness & Cyber Culture**

* Design and deliver cybersecurity and privacy awareness initiatives.
* Develop training content, phishing simulation programs, and executive awareness sessions.
* Support clients in building sustainable cyber risk awareness programs.

**Cybersecurity Architecture & Technical Reviews**

* Participate in security assessments across cloud, infrastructure, application security, identity and access management, and data security domains.
* Review technical controls and architectures against security best practices and industry standards.
* Identify gaps and recommend improvements aligned to organizational risk appetite.

**Research & Thought Leadership**

* Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats, industry trends, AI security developments, and evolving regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to thought leadership, methodologies, accelerators, and market-facing content.

**Role And Responsibilities**
**Client Delivery**

* Independently execute cybersecurity, privacy, and governance engagements with minimal supervision.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, control assessments, and documentation reviews.
* Analyze findings, prioritize risks, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Prepare high-quality client reports, presentations, and executive briefings.

**Project Management**

* Manage workstreams and deliverables while ensuring quality and adherence to timelines.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders and internal teams to drive project execution.
* Support proposal development, scoping activities, and business development efforts.

**Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Mentor Analysts and Associates through technical guidance and quality reviews.
* Foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.
* Contribute to capability building, knowledge sharing, and practice development initiatives.

**Business Development Support**

* Contribute to proposal preparation, market research, and solution development.
* Participate in client meetings, workshops, and networking activities.

**Continuous Learning**

* Stay current on cybersecurity, AI governance, privacy regulations, and industry best practices.
* Pursue relevant professional certifications and technical skill development.

**The Requirements**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 4-6 years of relevant cybersecurity consulting, risk advisory, or information security experience.
* Experience delivering cybersecurity assessments, governance reviews, privacy initiatives, or compliance programs.

**Technical Competencies**
**Cybersecurity Governance & Risk**

* Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and standards including: ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 22301, ISO 27701

**AI Security & Governance**

* Understanding of AI governance frameworks, AI risk management principles, and responsible AI practices.
* Awareness of emerging AI security risks including model security, prompt injection, adversarial attacks, and data privacy concerns.

**Data Privacy & Compliance**

* Experience working with DPDPA, GDPR, ISO 27701, or similar privacy regulations and standards.

**Preferred Certifications**

title: Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management (IAM Engineer)
description:
**Senior Engineer, Identity Access Management**
The Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer is responsible for supporting, administering, engineering, and continuously improving enterprise identity and access management services. This role works as part of the Digital Identity & Access team to deliver secure, reliable, and efficient identity services across the organization. The IAM Engineer will support identity lifecycle management, authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, application integrations, certificates, and related identity technologies. The successful candidate will combine strong technical capabilities with disciplined operational practices, documentation, change management, and collaboration across Technology and Information Security teams. This is a hybrid role and work hours are 2pm – 11pm IST.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Identity & Access Management**

* Support the administration and engineering of enterprise identity and access management platforms and services.
* Configure and maintain Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), authentication policies, and Conditional Access controls.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory identity services.
* Support identity lifecycle processes including user provisioning, modification, deprovisioning, and access changes.
* Troubleshoot complex authentication, authorization, and access-related issues.
* Support application onboarding and integration with enterprise identity platforms using technologies and standards such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and related authentication protocols.
* Support identity federation and authentication integrations with SaaS, cloud, and internally developed applications.
* Assist with the administration and support of Auth0 and other enterprise authentication platforms.
* Support role-based access control and group-based access management.

**Identity Security & Governance**

* Partner with Information Security to implement and maintain identity security standards and controls.
* Support periodic access reviews, certifications, audit requests, and compliance activities.
* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of appropriate separation-of-duties controls.
* Identify excessive, inappropriate, or outdated access and work with appropriate stakeholders to remediate identified issues.
* Support privileged identity and access management processes where applicable.
* Assist with investigation and remediation of identity-related security events.
* Ensure identity configurations and processes align with organizational security standards and established governance requirements.

**PKI & Certificate Management**

title: Senior RAMS Engineer
description:
RINA is a global knowledge company where expertise travels across borders, disciplines, and industries. Every day, we collaborate on solving complex challenges that no single field could tackle alone. With a presence in more than 70 countries and 160 years of heritage, we turn individual know-how into collective progress.
  
  
We are currently recruiting for a
**Senior RAMS Engineer**
to join our office in Mumbai within the
**Electronics and System Engineering**
Division.
  
  
**Mission**
Join the esteemed System Assurance Team within Railway Systems Engineering at RINA Consulting SpA, Mumbai branch, as a Senior RAMS Engineer. In this vital role, you will serve as a Railway Safety Expert, driving the delivery of comprehensive railway safety assurance throughout the project lifecycle. Your expertise will support seamless integration, compliance, and risk mitigation strategies, safeguarding the successful introduction of reliable railway systems. This position offers a meaningful career step for professionals passionate about advancing railway safety practices in a collaborative and innovative environment.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
Safety Engineering and Compliance
  
  

* Lead the development, allocation, and traceability management of safety requirements for railway subsystems, ensuring alignment with international safety standards such as EN 50126, EN 50128/EN 50716, EN 50129, IEC 61508, and CSM-RA.
* Conduct comprehensive technical reviews covering system architecture, design documents, interface agreements, and engineering change requests to validate safety compliance and effectiveness.
* Promote and apply Safety by Design methodologies, embedding defence-in-depth and formal risk reduction tactics to manage residual risks systematically.

Safety and RAMS Management
  
  

* Design and implement tailored Safety Management Plans and Safety Cases that address specific project needs, contractual requirements, and lifecycle stages.
* Organise and lead detailed hazard identification and risk assessment activities, utilising methodologies such as PHA, HAZID, HAZOP, FMEA/FMECA, FTA, and scenario-based analyses to detect and mitigate risks proactively.
* Manage hazard log processes, including hazard ownership assignment, implementation of control measures, evidence collection, residual risk evaluation, and on-time closure of hazards.
* Coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, railway operators, and maintenance providers to resolve interface safety concerns and promote integrated system assurance.

Construction, Testing, and Commissioning Support
  
  

* Ensure strict safety compliance during construction and installation phases, particularly in operational environments involving temporary works and degraded modes.
* Support integration efforts, facilitate test readiness assessments, oversee trial validations, commissioning activities, handover processes, and ensure all safety requirements are fulfilled prior to service entry.
* Lead safety reviews, audits, inspections, and readiness checks at critical project milestones and lifecycle phases to uphold regulatory and project safety standards.

Regulatory Compliance and Stakeholder Liaison
  
  

* Engage proactively with clients, railway authorities, Independent Safety Assessors, and certification bodies to ensure seamless regulatory compliance.
* Prepare, review and submit comprehensive safety evidence packages including compliance matrices and structured safety arguments to support authorisation and certification efforts.

Continuous Improvement and Technical Leadership
  
  

* Lead incident investigations and follow-up on audit findings and non-conformities, translating lessons learned into process enhancements and best practices.
* Monitor safety performance metrics and escalate critical safety risks, outstanding mitigations, and gaps in evidence to senior management promptly.
* Mentor junior engineers, review safety documentation, and conduct training workshops to enhance RAMS competence and safety culture within project teams and supply chains.

**Education**
Master’s Degree in Electronic/TLC Engineering or Electronics
  
  
**Qualifications**

* An accredited engineering degree or higher qualification in Electronic or Telecommunications Engineering or a related technical field.
* At least 10 years of demonstrable professional experience in railway system safety, RAMS engineering, and safety assurance, particularly in design review, integration, or system safety assessment roles.
* Extensive practical knowledge of EN 50126 and familiarity with EN 50128/EN 50716, EN 50129, IEC 61508, and CSM-RA standards and compliance procedures.
* Proven experience in producing or critically appraising Safety Management Plans, hazard logs, safety requirements, Safety Cases, and other assurance evidence on major railway projects.
* Thorough understanding of railway lifecycle phases, operational concepts, system interfaces, and integration challenges.
* Strong competency in advanced hazard analysis methods such as PHA, HAZID, HAZOP, FMEA/FMECA, and Fault Tree Analysis.
* Proficiency in crafting robust safety arguments, assessing evidence completeness, and communicating complex technical risks clearly to interdisciplinary stakeholders.
* Excellent leadership skills with the ability to facilitate, negotiate, and effectively engage with diverse teams and stakeholders in multicultural environments.
* Fluent professional English communication skills; additional languages and recognised certifications in RAMS, functional safety, or risk management will be advantageous.

**Competencies**

* WORKPLACE DYNAMICS - Resourcefulness in shaping progress and working efficiently.
* FORESIGHT & INSIGHT - Context awareness adopting a systemic perspective and informed decision making.
* PERSONAL EMPOWERMENT - Ownership for life, work and results, striving to grow professionally and personally.
* INTERPERSONAL INFLUENCE - Skills and strategies we use to interact effectively with others.
* DOMAIN & BUSINESS ACUMEN - Applying a scientific approach and critical thinking in operations and solution development within area of expertise.

At RINA, your growth drives our innovation. We bring together engineers, inspectors, digital minds and specialists from more than 100 nationalities, creating an environment where diverse perspectives sharpen how we think, collaborate and deliver.
  
  
Flexibility and respect drive how we work. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels valued and empowered to develop their potential. RINA provides equal employment opportunities and does not discriminate on any basis. We are compliant with Italian Law n. 68/99.

**Senior Cybersecurity Engineer – Agentic AI & SOC Engineering (4–7 Years)**
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer, you will help build next-generation SOC solutions by combining SIEM/XDR/SOAR with AI/LLM-driven automation. The role focuses on designing agent-based AI systems to enhance threat detection, automate investigations, and orchestrate response actions, while engaging in both hands-on engineering and client delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement agentic AI-driven SOC architectures integrated with SIEM, XDR, and SOAR
* Develop AI use cases for alert triage, investigation, incident summarization, and automated response
* Build and optimize detection use cases using rule-based and AI-assisted approaches
* Integrate LLM capabilities into SOC workflows (analysis, correlation, playbooks)
* Support platform deployment, migration, and tuning across SIEM/XDR environments
* Improve SOC efficiency through automation, noise reduction, and prioritization
* Operationalize threat intelligence into detection pipelines
* Collaborate with clients on solution design and implementation
* Create architecture diagrams, playbooks, and technical documentation
* Contribute to AI-driven SOC capability building

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4–7 years in Cybersecurity / SOC Engineering / Detection & Response
* Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, CrowdStrike, or Splunk
* Strong understanding of SIEM, SOAR, XDR/EDR, and detection engineering
* Exposure to AI/ML or LLM use cases in SOC environments
* Experience with automation (playbooks, APIs, scripting)
* Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-assisted workflows
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and incident response lifecycle
* Strong problem-solving and client communication skills

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, etc.)
* Exposure to Azure AI / OpenAI platforms
* Understanding of RAG, embeddings, or semantic search
* Experience integrating AI into SOC use cases (correlation, copilots, auto-remediation)
* Knowledge of cloud security / DevSecOps

**What You’ll Gain**

* Opportunity to work on advanced AI-driven SOC transformations
* Exposure to enterprise cybersecurity challenges
* Platform to contribute to innovation in AI-led detection and response
* Collaborative environment with global clients

title: Tech S and T-Infra- Automation Consultant-ISR-Senior-GDSF02
description:

**Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) – Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform**
**Experience: 6–9 years**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
  
  
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 6+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3+ years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform.
* Deep, production-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Qualification and Certifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to GCP and broader multi-cloud operating models.
* Experience with policy-as-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel).
* Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace.
* Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, internal developer platforms (IDP), release management, and SRE practices.

**Working Expectations**

* Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams across geographies.
* Maintain clear, version-controlled documentation for infrastructure design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts.
* Demonstrate strong ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, hardening security posture, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.
* Follow enterprise delivery standards, security controls, change and operational procedures, and quality expectations.

title: Inside Sales - Onefede.com (Cybersecurity Marketplace)
description:
**Company Description**
Onefede operates a global cybersecurity marketplace that connects buyers, sellers, and service partners in a unified ecosystem. The platform simplifies the identification, evaluation, and acquisition of cybersecurity products and services through a streamlined online process. Users gain access to innovative, best-of-breed emerging cybersecurity startups, as well as established services and solutions. By bringing all stakeholders together, Onefede helps organizations discover and adopt the right cybersecurity offerings efficiently and transparently.
  
**Role Description**
The Inside Sales role at Onefede is a full-time, on-site position based in Thane. This role involves engaging with prospective customers via phone, email, and online meetings to present Onefede’s cybersecurity marketplace offerings and convert leads into active users or clients. Day-to-day responsibilities include qualifying inbound and outbound leads, conducting product demos, managing a sales pipeline, and following up consistently to close opportunities. The position also includes maintaining accurate records in CRM tools, collaborating with marketing and product teams to refine sales messaging, and gathering customer feedback to improve the overall user experience. The role requires a strong focus on customer satisfaction and clear communication to build trust with cybersecurity buyers and partners.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Inside Sales and Lead Generation skills, including experience with prospecting, qualifying leads, and managing a sales funnel.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction skills, with the ability to understand client needs, address concerns, and build long-term relationships.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, both verbal and written, to explain complex concepts clearly and professionally.
* Candidates should preferably have familiarity with cybersecurity or technology marketplaces and experience using CRM and sales productivity tools.
* Candidates should have a results-driven mindset, the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and strong organizational and time-management skills.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is beneficial.
