title: Customer Experience Splunk Technical Leader
description:
**Meet the Team**
As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you are passionate about customers and will fuel solutions to ensure every customer request makes the deepest impact possible for our customers and share the best-of-the-best with the team. You will be a Splunk expert and adept at understanding, adapting, and guiding our account teams and customers on how to best use our Platform.
  
  
**Your impact**
**Responsibilities**

* Skilled and aligned to Splunk Security license products, such as Enterprise Security (ES), security applications like Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA), and/or SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response)
* Highly skilled and aligned to Splunk’s Core licensed product, such as Enterprise and Cloud.
* Strategically support the Customer Success Executive, Technical Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Solution Architect motions.
* Develop strong partnership with Sales/Customer Success roles to assist Area aligned customers with Value Realization. Activities include, but not limited to:

+ Onboarding & Enablement – deliver workshops, prescriptive guidance/assistance, achieve onboarding milestones
+ Health Review & Remediation
+ Security Use Case Activation
+ Proactively engaging Technical Success Engineers to review and assess their account’s health situation, with an emphasis on accounts that have telemetry risk signals and/or 6 months from renewal date.
+ Proactively engaging Customer Success Executives on adoption/use case-related work opportunity.
+ Proactively engage CS/SE Management to ensure priority focus alignment and address risk accounts themes.
+ Strategic case-based delivery, up to 90 days of assistance, which is requested by internal Area aligned account teams or management. This typically involves providing customers with high-quality technical advice on Enterprise level architecture, implementation, configuration and optimization work in complex environments for Splunk Enterprise Security, UBA/UEBA, and/or SOAR.

**As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you will**

* Be passionate about customers and deliver impactful solutions.
* Address organizations’ complex technical challenges, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact the customer.
* Be a self-motivated Splunk expert eager to learn and adapt in a multifaceted environment.
* Guide account team members and customers on optimal use of Splunk Platform and Splunk Enterprise Security. Provide recommendations for a customer’s overall technical health.
* Deliver strategic, case-based technical consulting (up to 90 days).
* Collaborate with internal resources and customer-facing teams to manage customer needs.
* Conduct research from various resources with the ability to consistently find answers to questions and solve complex technical problems.
* Execute consultative conversations with decision makers to diagnose and establish the potential value of solving business issues, change or expand existing solution requirements based on your discovery/assessment, and provide broader based recommendations to help customers accelerate their product initiatives, optimize cost, and maximize performance.
* Gain agreement with account team members and customer decision-makers on the tangible value of proposed solutions.
* Deliver customer onboarding enablement-based workshops and achieve success milestones.
* Contribute to practice KPIs through process and collateral improvements, tool development, and implementation.

**Minimum Qualifications-**

* Deep technical knowledge of Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) configuration, administration, and development, including expertise in Assets and Identities, Threat Intelligence, Notable Events, Adaptive Response, and Risk-based Analytics.
* Data Management: Experience with integrating and normalising data from diverse sources. Understanding of the Common Information Model (CIM) and experience with data onboarding, including forwarding architecture and technical add-ons.
* Strong command of Search Processing Language (SPL); experience developing and optimizing correlation and risk-based alerting rules.
* Strong Splunk architecture, data onboarding, and Splunk Core product feature experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cybersecurity Domain: Solid foundation in security operations, forensics, threat hunting, insider threats, and compliance.
* Cybersecurity Frameworks: Solid foundation in NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, PCI DSS
* Industry Standard Security Certifications: GIAC, CISSP, OSCP or equivalent
* Infrastructure: Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Splunk Certifications/Accreditations: ES Implementation Accreditation and/or SOAR consultant I & II
* Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments
* Statistical and analytical modeling skills are a plus.
* Proficiency with scripting languages (bash), application development (Java, Python, .NET), databases, and analytical tools.
* Hands-on experience with Splunk product implementation of focus and Splunk Cloud.
* Experience with cloud migration projects.
* Solid experience in technical consulting or big-data analytics.

**Soft Skills-**

* Trusted technical advisor with the ability to lead assigned tickets and priorities. Engages in “out of the box” thinking to resolve problems
* Relationship Management - Establish technical credibility with a wide range of internal and customer contacts with the ability to “read” the internal/customer contact and adapt behavior / approach
* Conflict Resolution - Ability to engage in escalation management
* Influencing/Negotiating - Ability to influence peers, Splunk leadership and customers. Ability to handle highly complex/distributed IT environments and/or accounts that demand a high level of negotiation and conflict resolution abilities
* Problem/Need Identification - Demonstrates a deep comprehension of the customers, account team and/or customer’s business strategy, business objectives & challenges, success criteria/how customer measures success, and training needs. Analyzes trends to predict changes that may impact customer’s long-term business goals
* Mentor/Team Player - Possesses ability to take on mentorship roles as identified by management team. Identifies, defines, and leads Priorities to Improve to help team reach its goals
* Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills. Active listening and objective consideration of others’ opinions.
* Strong customer-facing skills to instill confidence and guide towards resolution.
* Ability to balance multiple account teams, customers and challenging priorities effectively.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix
*®*
Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix
*®*
Assessment 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking a highly skilled Security Operations SME (L3) to serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex and high-severity cyber incidents. This role plays a critical part in leading advanced investigations, incident response, proactive threat hunting, and continuous improvement of detection and monitoring capabilities within the Security Operations Center (SOC). The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Infrastructure, Endpoint, Network, Cloud, and Application teams to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.
  
  

* Role: Security Operations SME (L3)
* Location: Mumbai
* Experience: 8 to 12 Years
* Job Type: Full-Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Act as the Level 3 escalation point for complex, high-severity, and multi-domain security incidents.
* Lead deep-dive investigations to determine attack scope, root cause, affected assets, business impact, and attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures.
* Drive incident containment, eradication, recovery, post-incident reviews, and corrective-action tracking with relevant technical teams.
* Conduct advanced analysis across SIEM events, endpoint telemetry, network traffic, identity activity, cloud logs, malware indicators, and threat intelligence sources.
* Perform proactive threat hunting and develop threat-hunting hypotheses aligned with MITRE ATT&CK and emerging threat patterns.
* Design, tune, validate, and maintain correlation rules, detection use cases, alerts, dashboards, and investigation content.
* Reduce false positives, identify detection gaps, and improve monitoring coverage using lessons learned from incidents and threat intelligence.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, SOPs, runbooks, escalation procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Optimize SIEM, EDR/XDR, SOAR, and related security tools while troubleshooting integration, monitoring, performance, and data quality issues.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, case reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions for L1 and L2 analysts.
* Prepare incident reports, root-cause analyses, executive summaries, and technical recommendations.
* Support audits, tabletop exercises, service reviews, operational metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in shift rotations and on-call support for critical security incidents as required.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* Extensive experience in Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, incident response, security monitoring, and cyber investigations.
* Advanced hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk Enterprise Security, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, or equivalent solutions.
* Experience with EDR/XDR technologies including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike Falcon, Carbon Black, or similar platforms.
* Strong log analysis expertise across endpoint, network, server, application, identity, and cloud data sources.
* Deep knowledge of threat hunting, IOC analysis, attack-chain reconstruction, malware triage, and digital forensic fundamentals.
* Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, common cyberattack techniques, threat actor methodologies, and incident response lifecycle management.
* Experience developing, tuning, and optimizing SIEM correlation rules, threat detection content, searches, alerts, dashboards, and reports.
* Exposure to SOAR platforms, automated workflows, orchestration playbooks, and security automation initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, Active Directory, Entra ID, authentication technologies, and cloud environments.
* Scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Experience working within enterprise SOC or Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) environments.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, Splunk, Microsoft Security, CrowdStrike, or equivalent security certifications.
* Experience presenting incident findings and security recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to manage high-severity incidents and drive effective incident response activities.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities for guiding junior analysts and improving SOC maturity.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong focus on continuous improvement, detection engineering, threat intelligence integration, and operational excellence.
* Commitment to staying current with evolving cybersecurity threats, technologies, and industry best practices.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment**
Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
The Senior Security Engineer plays a key role in embedding security into the design and build phases of technology projects, ensuring solutions are secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise security standards. Reporting to the Head of Information Security Transformation, this role provides hands-on technical expertise to uplift security capabilities and support the delivery of secure solutions across the organisation.
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus 
  

* Actively contribute to technology projects during design and build phases, ensuring security is embedded early and effectively.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, and delivery teams to review technical designs and provide security input into solution architecture.
* Translate security requirements into practical implementation guidance, ensuring alignment with business objectives and compliance standards.
* Participate in project planning, estimations, and workshops to represent security interests and influence outcomes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of secure design patterns and delivery processes.

  
Operational Management 
  

* Design and implement security solutions across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.
* Support integration of security controls into CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and infrastructure-as-code environments.
* Deploy and manage tools such as DLP, WAF, DAM, endpoint protection, SIEM, and IAM solutions.
* Conduct technical risk assessments, threat modelling, and control validation during project execution.
* Serve as a point of escalation for complex technical security issues during project implementation.
* Contribute to the design and build of secure cloud-first environments, primarily in Microsoft Azure.
* Apply in-depth understanding of network, compute, and storage security across hybrid cloud environments.
* Support secure configuration, monitoring, and hardening of systems in collaboration with infrastructure and platform teams.
* Leverage hands-on experience with technologies including Microsoft Entra ID, Office 365, Zscaler, Citrix, CASB, and Active Directory.
* Prepare documentation including build guides, runbooks, and security implementation plans.

  
People Leadership 
  

* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior engineers within the team or project streams.
* Actively engage in team stand-ups, architecture reviews, and delivery retrospectives to share learnings and promote secure delivery practices.
* Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams and promote shared accountability for secure outcomes.

  
Governance & Risk
  

* Review configuration changes and provide input into security policies and control baselines during build activities.
* Support audit readiness and evidence gathering for new solutions.
* Ensure all designs and implementations comply with internal policies and regulatory obligations, including privacy and data-protection requirements.
* Identify security gaps or control failures during project delivery and support timely remediation.

  
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.
  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  
Experience 
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent, with a major in Information Security or Cybersecurity preferred.
* Minimum 7+ years in technical security roles, with a demonstrated record of delivering complex security initiatives across design, build, assurance, and operational transition.
* Hands-on experience with cloud, data, and Zero Trust security technologies such as Microsoft Defender Suite, Microsoft Purview, Zscaler or Netskope, CASB, data loss prevention, secure access service edge, and web application firewalls.
* Experience with enterprise identity and access technologies such as Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SailPoint, CyberArk, and Okta, including SSO and integration standards such as SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SCIM.
* Exposure to security operations and governance platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, CrowdStrike, vulnerability-management tooling, and ServiceNow Security Operations or GRC.
* Ability to apply enterprise security standards, regulatory obligations, and risk-management requirements within complex, product-centric delivery environments.
* Deep expertise in one or more priority domains—particularly identity, cloud, privileged access, or Zero Trust—is preferred; candidates are not expected to have experience with every listed technology.

  
Personal Attributes
  

* Strong technical problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Effective communicator who can translate security concepts into actionable guidance for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary project teams while managing multiple concurrent priorities.
* Demonstrates a proactive, hands-on mindset with a focus on secure enablement and delivery excellence.

title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
The Identity and Access Management Engineer (Junior) will supports the secure and reliable operation of identity services across the organisation. Working under the guidance of senior team members, the role assists with user lifecycle management, access provisioning, authentication, single sign-on, privileged access and identity governance activities.
  
The position contributes to project delivery and operational support by following approved standards, documenting work, resolving routine issues and escalating risks or complex technical matters appropriately.
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus
  

* Support the secure and reliable operation of identity and access management services across the organisation.
* Contribute to IAM, PAM and identity governance initiatives through project delivery and operational support activities.
* Assist in implementing identity standards, controls and automation aligned with the organisation’s security strategy.
* Support continuous improvement of identity lifecycle, authentication and privileged access capabilities.

  
Operational Management
  

* Manage approved joiner, mover and leaver activities, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, access changes and routine IAM troubleshooting.
* Provision, modify and remove user, service and privileged accounts across supported on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Apply approved access models, including role-based and attribute-based access controls, group membership and entitlements.
* Support periodic access reviews and follow up outstanding certifications, exceptions and remediation actions.
* Assist with the administration, configuration, testing and support of hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments.
* Support application onboarding for single sign-on, multifactor authentication and automated provisioning using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SCIM.
* Contribute to PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and other scripts or workflows that automate repeatable IAM activities, with peer review before production use.
* Assist with identity services hosted across Azure and AWS and their supporting Windows, Linux and virtualised infrastructure.
* Maintain daily IAM platform stability and compliance through service monitoring, BAU engineering, incident troubleshooting, fulfilment of service requests and controlled changes.
* Troubleshoot access, authentication, federation, directory and provisioning issues using documented procedures, system logs and structured diagnostic techniques.
* Support Active Directory Domain Services and related technologies such as LDAP, Group Policy, DNS, certificate services, forest trusts and remote access services under appropriate guidance.
* Maintain accurate tickets, work notes, configuration records, operational procedures and handover information.

  
People Leadership
  

* Build effective working relationships with application owners, Service Desk, infrastructure, cloud, security and project teams.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and Identity Architects to deliver IAM and PAM enhancements.
* Demonstrate accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.
* Share knowledge and contribute to team capability through structured learning and practical assignments.

  
Governance & Risk
  

* Support the discovery and onboarding of privileged accounts across servers, databases, cloud platforms and enterprise applications.
* Assist with implementation and uplift of privileged-access controls, including conditional access, multifactor authentication, least privilege, account discovery and automated password rotation.
* Follow least-privilege, segregation-of-duties, privacy and privileged-access requirements when administering identity services.
* Support audit and assurance activities by maintaining complete access records, approvals, evidence and operational documentation.
* Identify control gaps, recurring incidents and opportunities for automation or service improvement and escalate recommendations through the appropriate process.
* Escalate risks, exceptions and complex technical matters through appropriate governance processes.

  
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.
  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  
Experience
  

* Degree, diploma or equivalent practical training in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in IAM, directory services, systems administration, IT support or cybersecurity; graduates with relevant practical exposure are encouraged to apply.
* Foundational understanding of identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, least privilege, conditional access, multifactor authentication, RBAC and ABAC.
* Practical exposure to Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in a hybrid environment; familiarity with Microsoft Identity Manager or Entra ID Connect is advantageous.
* Working knowledge of SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, federation and API concepts.
* Basic to intermediate PowerShell and scripting capability; exposure to Microsoft Graph is desirable.
* Awareness of Windows Server and Active Directory services, including Group Policy, DNS, certificate services and forest trusts.
* Foundational cloud knowledge across Azure or AWS and basic familiarity with virtualisation; Linux exposure is desirable.
* Exposure to PAM or IGA platforms such as CyberArk and SailPoint is advantageous.
* Relevant Microsoft, cloud, IAM or security certifications are desirable but not essential.

Personal Attributes

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work independently on assigned tasks and seek guidance for complex or high-risk matters.
* Balanced interest in operational support, incident resolution, debugging and engineering delivery.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to approvals, testing, evidence and record keeping.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build constructive relationships with technical teams and business partners.
* Able to prioritise assigned work, meet agreed deadlines, raise blockers early and contribute effectively in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrates integrity, accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.

title: Chief Technology Officer – Cybersecurity Services
description:
**Chief Technology Officer – Cybersecurity Services**

**Mumbai based | Reporting to the Board | Group technology leadership**

Our client is a fast-growing, founder-led cybersecurity and digital services group partnering with more than 600 clients worldwide, many in highly regulated industries. It delivers end to end, from advisory through to 24x7 managed security, alongside cloud, data and AI, and has strategic partnerships with leading AI and enterprise platform vendors.

The CTO will be a strategic partner to the executive team and the senior technical authority for the business. A background built in cybersecurity is essential, ideally within a GSI, a top global consultancy or a leading cybersecurity firm.

* Own the technology vision for an established, founder-backed business with proven delivery capability and a strong, loyal client base
* Shape offerings at the convergence of cybersecurity, AI and enterprise platforms, backed by strategic technology partnerships

* Build, mentor and scale high-performing technology and engineering teams

* Represent the business with customers, analysts and industry forums as a technology evangelist

* Build relationships with CXOs, CISOs and CIOs across client organisations

**Governance and operational excellence**

* Set technology governance, architecture standards and engineering best practice

* Has led cyber delivery or architecture across multiple regions, with large, distributed teams
* Hands-on architecture depth across SIEM, EDR/MDR, vulnerability management, application and cloud security (AWS and Azure) and Zero Trust
* A track record of creating reusable IP, such as detection libraries, response playbooks, accelerators or patented solutions
* A strong grasp of risk, compliance and governance alongside security operations
* Confident with boards, CXOs, CISOs and strategic clients

**Advantageous**

* Ownership of a practice P&L or a revenue number for technology-led services
* Experience bringing agentic AI and automation into security operations
* Experience helping clients secure their own AI adoption, including AI governance
* Experience with enterprise workflow, risk and cloud platforms
* Experience building partner-aligned offerings with hyperscalers and the major security vendors

* Stronger, differentiated offerings with strategic technology partners
* A mature, engaged technology team, with key hires made and retained

Highly competitive base and variable. An outstanding career opportunity for the right leader, based in Mumbai.

All approaches are handled in strict confidence. For a conversation, contact Niall Cook at definITion: niall@definition.ltd

title: GMS-Senior-BeyondTrust
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cyber Managed Services – Privileged Identity & Access Management – Senior Consultant (BeyondTrust PAM – Operations)**
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Consultant – BeyondTrust PAM Operations to join our Cyber Managed Services team. This role focuses on delivering ongoing operational support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of BeyondTrust PAM environments for our clients. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in BeyondTrust operations, strong troubleshooting skills, and a commitment to ensuring secure and reliable access to privileged systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 operational support for BeyondTrust PAM-related issues, including access failures, session management disruptions, and system performance concerns.
* Perform day-to-day administration of privileged accounts within the BeyondTrust platform — including provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, and policy updates as per change requests.

**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
****Process Overview****
The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.
  
  
GIS Identity & Access management (IAM) Access Control Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.
  
  
****Job Description****
The Data Engineering Services team is seeking a hands-on IAM Data Scientist to deliver advanced analytics, AI/ML solutions, and data engineering capabilities that strengthen Identity and Access Management controls, governance, and risk reduction across the enterprise.
  
  
This role will require to transform complex access, entitlement, identity lifecycle, privileged access, and control data into actionable insights. The candidate will design and develop scalable data pipelines, predictive and detective analytics, AI/ML models, dashboards, and self-service reporting capabilities that help identify control gaps, access anomalies, toxic combinations, certification inefficiencies, and emerging IAM risks. The role requires strong technical depth in analytics, model development, model governance, AI risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to convert data science outcomes into measurable control improvements and executive-ready risk narratives.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Lead advanced analytics and data science initiatives across IAM controls, access governance, entitlement management, privileged access, joiner-mover-leaver processes, access certifications, and policy adherence.
* Analyze large, complex, and disparate identity, access, entitlement, control, application, and audit datasets to identify trends, anomalies, control gaps, risk concentrations, and opportunities for automation.
* Design, build, validate, and tune AI/ML models for IAM use cases such as access anomaly detection, entitlement mining, role mining, toxic access identification, certification prioritization, privileged access monitoring, and control effectiveness measurement.
* Develop scalable data pipelines, feature engineering processes, reusable datasets, and analytics frameworks using Python, R, SQL, Splunk, Neo4j, and enterprise-approved data platforms.
* Design and maintain executive-ready dashboards, scorecards, and self-service reporting solutions that convert IAM control data into actionable insights for process owners, risk partners, and senior leadership.
* Embed model governance and AI risk controls into the analytics lifecycle, including documentation, model inventory, validation evidence, explainability, performance monitoring, drift detection, data lineage, reproducibility, and audit traceability.
* Assess and mitigate AI/ML risks including bias, privacy exposure, data quality limitations, explainability gaps, inappropriate automation, overfitting, and adversarial or unintended use of model outputs.
* Partner with IAM, GIS, cyber risk, audit, compliance, privacy, technology, and application teams to translate control requirements into measurable analytics solutions and governance outcomes.
* Drive process improvement and automation by identifying manual control activities, inefficient data handoffs, recurring exceptions, and opportunities to strengthen preventative and detective IAM controls.
* Prepare clear documentation, control evidence, methodology summaries, model performance updates, and risk narratives to support governance reviews, audit readiness, and management reporting.

****Requirements****
**Education :**
B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc./BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)
  
  
**Certifications If Any**
: NA
  
  
**Experience Range : 10**
+ years
  
  
****Foundational Skills****

* Expertise in advanced data analytics and statistical modeling using Python, R, and SQL
* Proficiency in data visualization and graph analytics using Neo4j, Tableau, or equivalent tools
* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management architecture, technology and standards
* Strong quantitative analysis, data intuition, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills
* Proficiency in AI, machine learning, data mining, feature engineering, and statistical analysis
* Excellent verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and executive presentation skills
* Proven experience in end-to-end model development lifecycle including data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, deployment readiness, monitoring, drift detection, and performance tuning
* Strong knowledge of model governance practices including model documentation, model inventory, model cards, approval workflows, control evidence, audit traceability, and alignment with enterprise risk management expectations
* Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate AI/ML risks including bias, explainability gaps, privacy exposure, data quality issues, model drift, overfitting, adversarial misuse, and inappropriate automation of access decisions
* Experience applying AI/ML techniques to IAM datasets such as entitlement mining, access anomaly detection, role mining, toxic access identification, privileged access monitoring, joiner-mover-leaver patterns, and access certification optimization

****Desired Skills****

* Experience with data storytelling and reporting design that helps stakeholders make actionable control and risk decisions
* Experience building dashboards or graph-based analysis views using Tableau, Neo4j, or similar platforms
* Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Experience with MLOps practices and tools such as MLflow, model registry, CI/CD for analytics, automated model testing, experiment tracking, monitoring dashboards, and controlled promotion of models across environments
* Exposure to generative AI, large language models, prompt evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation concepts, and safe use of AI assistants for control evidence summarization, policy mapping, and IAM insights

description:

Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. **Overview**
Be on the front line of defending General Mills. As an Associate Analyst in our Cyber Security Incident Response team, you will investigate real threats such as phishing, malware and compromised accounts, and help stop them before they affect our people, systems and brands.You will learn from experienced responders, get hands-on with enterprise-grade investigation and automation tools.Every day you will work with fellow analysts and team leads, our detection engineering, technology teams and business partners across the globe.

description:

* Create SOPs, runbooks, and training materials and provide knowledge transfer to site security and facilities teams.
* Provide dedicated coverage during rotational night shift hours (7:00 PM – 4:00 AM India time) to support real-time monitoring, escalations, and time-sensitive vendor/site coordination.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of overall IT experience and 5+ years of overall Physical Security experience, with hands-on experience configuring and supporting Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Visitor Management systems.
* Experience administering Access Control platforms (e.g., AMAG or similar), including panel/reader configuration, credentialing, and access group management.
* Hands-on experience with Video Management Systems (e.g., Milestone or similar), including camera commissioning, network configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Visitor Management platforms (e.g., SPLAN or similar) and visitor workflow configuration.
* Experience with system integrations and data interfaces, such as APIs, identity/directory services, HR systems, badging systems, visitor management, and monitoring platforms.
* Working knowledge of IP networking fundamentals (IP addressing, VLANs, network diagrams) and ability to create and maintain technical documentation and as-built diagrams.
* Experience coordinating with security integrators, hardware/software vendors, and site/facilities teams on installation and service delivery.
* Strong incident management skills, with the ability to triage, escalate, and resolve issues within defined SLAs.
* Knowledge of Physical Security Infrastructure, including controllers, readers, locks, door hardware, video servers, PoE, cabling, UPS, and low-voltage design.
* Knowledge of security system compliance, cybersecurity, and industry best practices for access control and surveillance systems.
* Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently across multiple global sites.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and manage external vendor relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security issues to nontechnical stakeholders.
* Willingness and flexibility to work rotational night shift hours (7:00 PM – 4:00 AM India time) to support global site coverage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* Relevant certifications in physical security systems (e.g., AMAG, Milestone, or equivalent) preferred.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Assistant Manager - Enterprise IT
description:
**Position Overview**
We require an experienced L2 Windows Domain & Backup Engineer to manage and maintain enterprise Windows environments along with backup and recovery infrastructure. The role includes Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and core Windows services, along with enterprise backup administration, monitoring, and recovery operations. The engineer will also perform assessments, reporting, compliance activities, and enable automation using scripting/AI tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Windows Infrastructure Management
  
  

* Administer Active Directory (Users, Groups, GPOs, OU structure)
* Maintain DNS, DHCP, and RADIUS (NPS) services
* Manage Windows Server environments (2016/2019/2022) including installation, configuration, and upgrades
* Ensure high availability and performance optimization of Windows infrastructure

Backup Administration
  
  

* Manage and monitor enterprise backup solutions (e.g., NetBackup, BackupExec, Veeam, Commvault, or similar)
* Perform backup scheduling, configuration, and policy management for servers, databases, and applications
* Ensure successful completion of daily backups and troubleshoot failed backup jobs
* Perform data restoration (file-level, VM-level, and application-level) as per business requirements
* Conduct regular backup validation and restoration drills to ensure recoverability
* Manage backup storage, retention policies, and archival processes
* Optimize backup performance and storage utilization
* Coordinate with application and infrastructure teams during backup and restore activities
* Ensure DR readiness by supporting disaster recovery drills and failover testing
* Maintain backup reports, logs, and documentation

Security & Vulnerability Management
  
  

* Perform Windows patch management (monthly/critical updates)
* Identify and remediate vulnerabilities using tools like Qualys/Nessus
* Ensure SLA-based closure of vulnerabilities
* Implement server hardening best practices
* Ensure backup data security, encryption, and access controls
* Ensure compliance with ISO 27001 and internal policies
* Prepare documentation for audits (including backup and recovery evidence)
* Track audit findings and remediation
* Maintain security and backup baselines

Incident & Change Management
  
  

* Handle L2/L3 incidents related to Windows infrastructure and backup systems
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for failures (including backup failures)
* Support change management processes for infra and backup changes

**Required Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**
Strong experience in Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, RADIUS/NPS; Windows Server (2016/2019/2022/2025); patch management tools (WSUS/SCCM/Intune/Bigfix)
  
  
**Backup Tools:**
Experience in enterprise backup tools (NetBackup, Veeam, Commvault, etc.)
  
  
**Security:**
Knowledge of ISO 27001 and security frameworks; experience with vulnerability tools (Qualys, Nessus)
  
  
**Scripting:**
PowerShell scripting for automation
  
  
**Certifications (Preferred):**
Microsoft certifications (MCSA, Azure Admin); certifications in backup technologies (Veeam/Commvault/NetBackup)
  
  
**Environment:**
Experience in enterprise multi-domain environments; exposure to hybrid environments (on-prem + Azure/GCP); exposure to AI/automation tools
  
  
**Key Skills & Competencies**
**Communication:**
Strong documentation and reporting skills; effective communication and coordination with IT and business teams
  
  
**Attention to Detail:**
High attention to detail in backup validation, security compliance, and audit readiness
  
  
**Resilience:**
Ability to work in high-pressure production environments with SLA-bound deliverables
  
  
**Problem-Solving:**
Root cause analysis; incident management; proactive vulnerability remediation

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Airports Holding Limited**
: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Lead - Security Automation & Loss Prevention is responsible for leading and managing the day-to-day operations of the security automation and loss prevention team. This involves maintaining of security equipment with highest availability and adherence to maintenance strategy. The role requires design evaluation, implementing and maintaining security system and technologies, optimizing processes to prevent revenue leakage, and ensuring compliance with established security protocols. The Lead also drives team performance, supports investigation and risk management efforts, and works closely with the Security Head to meet regulatory, financial and operational objectives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Operational Support and Technology Evaluation:**
Oversee the deployment and evaluation of design parameters of security systems like surveillance, , radio communication, screening system (CTiX, XBis, FBS, DFMD, ETD, EVD, LED etc.) access controls and attendance system, video management, radio active detection equipment's, QRT equipments, BDDS equipment and intrusion detection.
  
  
Ensure highest availability of Airport security control room like SOCC (Security Control Centre), AHCR (Anti Hijack Control Room) for smooth operation and optimum vigilance of the Airport.
  
  
Ensure maintenance (preventive, corrective and predictive) and up gradation of the installed security automations systems, applications, equipment and other technology assets, ensuring the highest availability and maintenance standards for security technologies and systems.
  
  
Regularly evaluate the effectiveness of implemented technologies and suggest improvements to meet operational needs.
  
  
Ensure implementation of regulatory orders, audit points for enhancing the deployed security system in Airport.
  
  
Ensure implementation of visitor access card management system, CACS system and the Airport Entry Permit System (AEP) in coordination with pass section teams.
  
  
**Team Leadership And Development**
Lead the security automation and loss prevention team, ensuring the successful implementation of security technologies and processes.

title: Operational Risk, Officer
description:
Role Summary
  
  
State Street uses third parties to support internal processes and the delivery of products and services to clients。 These relationships are evaluated and risk-assessed through the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM ) Program.
  
  
The Third-Party Risk Management Officer will support the effective execution of activities across one or more TPRM lifecycle pillars. Depending on business requirements, the role may include reviewing TPRM cases and engagement records, reviewing and challenging inherent risk assessments, coordinating supplier due diligence outreach, monitoring and reviewing due diligence submissions, preparing executive summaries, and managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will apply sound risk judgement, identify and resolve data or process inconsistencies, maintain complete and accurate records, and communicate TPRM requirements and assessment outcomes clearly. The role requires close collaboration with Engagement Managers, third-party suppliers, risk-domain subject matter experts, Business Advisors, Procurement, Legal, and TPRM teams to support timely, consistent, policy-aligned, and audit-ready outcomes。
  
  
**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of State Street’s business lines, products and services, third-party operating model, and TPRM lifecycle requirements。
* Review and evaluate TPRM SNOW cases, Archer engagement records, assessment records, and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable policies, standards and procedures
* Manage assigned case queues, review and effectively challenge TPRM cases and support business lines in faster onboarding of third party suppliers.
* Review inherent risk assessments for reasonableness and accuracy, including engagement scope, service description, data access, technology dependencies, regulatory considerations, and other relevant risk factors.
* Identify inconsistencies or gaps in inherent risk questionnaire responses and work with Engagement Managers and relevant stakeholders to resolve issues before approval.
* Apply knowledge of inherent risk questionnaire logic, scoring, question interdependencies, and due diligence triggers to confirm that the resulting inherent risk rating and due diligence requirements are appropriate.
* Prepare and distribute due diligence questionnaires and supporting requirements to third-party suppliers or internal service providers within established timelines.
* Monitor due diligence progress, perform follow-ups and escalations, and maintain clear records of outreach, responses, decisions, and outstanding actions.
* Perform completeness and quality reviews of returned due diligence questionnaires and supporting artifacts before routing the assessment to the appropriate risk-domain subject matter experts.
* Coordinate follow-up questions, clarification discussions, and supplier meetings; track responses and facilitate resolution of outstanding items.
* Review and analyse due diligence results, assessment conclusions, control-effectiveness ratings, and identified findings to confirm that outcomes are sufficiently supported and accurately documented.
* Prepare clear, concise, and audit-ready executive summaries that communicate the engagement scope, inherent risk profile, due diligence results, control effectiveness, findings, residual concerns, and required acknowledgement or next steps.
* Coordinate executive-summary review and issuance with Engagement Managers, Executive Sponsors, Business Advisors, risk-domain subject matter experts, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with third-party suppliers, Engagement Managers, business stakeholders, Procurement, Legal, risk-domain subject matter experts, and TPRM partner teams.
* Explain TPRM requirements, risk-analysis conclusions, findings, and remediation expectations clearly and professionally, and guide stakeholders toward timely resolution.
* Ensure that TPRM decisions, approvals, exceptions, and supporting evidence are accurately captured in Archer and relevant repositories to support governance, audit, and regulatory review.
* Support the preparation of management information, metrics, trend analysis, and status reporting for TPRM leadership and governance forums.
* Maintain and enhance procedures, checklists, templates, job aids, frequently asked questions, and other process documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, data quality, control effectiveness, stakeholder experience, and consistency of TPRM outcomes.
* Participate in system testing, process-change initiatives, remediation programmes, quality-assurance reviews, audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Maintain flexibility to work across TPRM pillars and support emerging programme priorities arising from business, regulatory, policy, technology, or operating-model changes.
* Perform all responsibilities in accordance with State Street’s risk appetite, policies, standards, ethical requirements, and control expectations.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of third-party risk management principles, lifecycle activities, and governance requirements within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Sound risk judgement and the ability to assess the reasonableness, completeness, and consistency of information and supporting evidence.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify gaps, challenge assumptions, and develop practical resolution paths.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise executive-level summaries and explain risk conclusions to stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong stakeholder and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes while maintaining professional and constructive working relationships.
* Ability to manage multiple cases, competing priorities, and tight deadlines in a high-volume, control-focused environment.
* Strong organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with close attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently, exercise appropriate judgement, and escalate matters based on risk, urgency, and programmed requirements.
* Strong customer-centric mindset and commitment to providing clear guidance and responsive support to business and supplier stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to identify issues, follow through on actions, and achieve timely and sustainable resolution.
* Ability to interpret and apply policies, standards, procedures, trigger logic, risk-rating methodologies, and service-level requirements consistently.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and related reporting tools.
* Working knowledge of Archer or a comparable governance, risk, and compliance platform is preferred.
* Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable supporting change, process improvement, and evolving TPRM programme requirements.
* High ethical standards, professional integrity, and commitment to maintaining appropriate confidentiality.

**Qualifications**

* Overall professional experience of 10 or more years, preferably within banking, financial services, risk management, compliance, procurement, audit, controls, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in Third-Party Risk Management, operational risk, supplier risk, vendor management, due diligence, or another risk-and-control function.
* Practical experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: TPRM case review, inherent risk assessment, due diligence outreach and completeness review, risk assessment coordination, findings management, executive-summary preparation, or stakeholder relationship management.
* General knowledge of third-party risk domains, including Operational Resiliency, Operational Risk, Cybersecurity, Information Sensitivity and Access, Privacy, Physical Security, Reputational Risk, Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Bribery and Corruption, Financial Viability, and Tax Evasion.
* Experience working with internal stakeholders, third-party suppliers, and subject matter experts in a matrixed and globally distributed organisation.
* Experience preparing management reporting, governance materials, executive communications, audit evidence, or regulatory-response documentation is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, risk management, technology, law, or a related discipline; a postgraduate management qualification is preferred.
* Relevant professional certification such as CRVPM, CRISC, CISM, CISA, CBCI, or an equivalent risk-management qualification is advantageous.
* Prior experience with Archer or a comparable governance, risk, and compliance platform is preferred.
* Please note: The role is required to support internal clients during the first half of US working hours.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
  
  
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Operations Governance Manager
description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?
  
  
AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.
  
  
Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…
  
  
Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.
  
  
**A Snapshot**
As Operations Governance Manager, you will report to the Director of Operations Governance and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways:
  
  

* You will work closely with key business teams to drive, structure, and deliver key data centre operational excellence, governance and compliance initiatives across the APJ region.
* You will advise on and shape data centre operational excellence and assurance throughout AirTrunk, including the initiation and delivery of new build sites, ensuring compliance from a risk management perspective to enable the rapid expansion of AirTrunk data centre developments across APJ.
* You will be able to hone new skills and expertise in related workstreams as required, including risk management, business continuity, and emergency response, developing an in-depth knowledge of AirTrunk’s operations and providing strategic operational initiatives.

**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Management of data centre operational excellence, governance and controls.
* Support the development and implementation of consistent operational practices across regions and sites.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, procedures, controls and supporting tools.
* Monitor recurring findings and trends to determine whether broader organisational improvements are required.
* Assist and support assurance activities for all operating sites including; external, internal, client, certification and insurer assurance.
* Management of DC sites’ assurance, measuring and monitoring adherence to operational process and procedures.  Give feedback to sites on common shortcomings and risk consequence.
* Coordinate and undertake Severity 1 drills for DC sites, following up on identified lessons learnt and improvements.
* Lead or support improvement initiatives arising from assurance findings, incidents, drills, controlled self-assessments and lessons learned.
* Monitor and support site teams in the delivery of their Business Continuity, Emergency response and any other required resiliency planning.
* Monitor nominated document owners and managers, in timely review and update of their business unit relevant documentation and keep the Governance owned frameworks and policies up to date for review in consultation with stakeholders.
* Support Operations teams in identifying and understanding relevant regulatory, statutory, certification and internal compliance obligations.
* Work with relevant subject matter experts to assess changes in regulatory or compliance requirements that may impact Data Centre Operations.
* Assessment and tracking of DC sites operational risk, working with site teams to effectively manage, control and/or mitigate these risks.

**Requirements**

* Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent professional experience in operations, engineering, risk, compliance, governance, quality or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience in operational governance, assurance, compliance, risk management or operational excellence.
* Experience working within a critical infrastructure, data centre, engineering, utilities, facilities management or similarly high-reliability operational environment.
* Strong understanding of operational risk and control principles.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse complex operational issues and identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities.
* Ability to travel regularly across operational sites within the APAC region.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, attention to detail, and the ability to create and direct cross-functional group forums for managing risks.

**The AirTrunk Culture**
Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.
  
  
The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.
  
  
Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.
  
  
Now’s your chance to Grow@Hyperscale.
  
  

* To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.\*\*

* Foster teamwork and lead by example

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 5-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages- Python, JSON, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification

**Certifications:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

**What We Look For**

* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
