title: Architect
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Technical Expertise — Act as the Senior Technical Expert for R&S, datacenter networking and wireless technologies, providing deep-dive guidance to internal teams and customers.
* Complex Problem Diagnosis — Perform advanced analysis and diagnosis of complex networking and security issues across multi-vendor environments.
* Solution Deployment — Deploy and support multi-vendor network and security solutions, ensuring stability, scalability, and compliance with design standards.
* Monitoring & Management Tools — Deploy and support network and security monitoring/management tools, ensuring visibility and proactive issue detection.
* Documentation Ownership — Prepare and update HLDs, LLDs, operational processes, and technical documentation for ongoing and new deployments.
* Sev-1/MIM Incident Support — Provide expert support during incidents to ensure resolution within SLA and minimize business impact.
* Root Cause Analysis — Perform RCA based on OEM inputs and internal investigation, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Continuous Improvement — Identify improvement opportunities and recommend enhancements for network and security infrastructure.
* Tool Evaluation — Evaluate new tools and technologies (automation platforms, observability suites, AI-driven NMS), produce recommendations and support effort estimation for new project opportunities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with global IT teams, OEMs, vendors, partners, and service providers to ensure seamless operations and project execution.
* Training & Knowledge Transfer — Provide technical training and mentorship to L1/L2 operations teams to uplift capability and reduce escalations.
* Technology Up-skilling — Continuously learn and stay updated with the latest networking and security technologies, OEM releases, and industry best practices.
* Project Leadership — Act as the key SPOC for transition, transformation, organic growth, and greenfield/brownfield network projects.

**About You**

* Core Networking — 12–15+ years of hands-on experience in Routing & Switching, Wireless, Datacenter Networking, and Security across enterprise environments.
* Multi-Vendor Implementation — Proven implementation and operational experience with multi-vendor OEMs (Cisco, Aruba, Juniper, etc.).
* Wireless & RF Technologies — Strong background in RF technologies, wireless security, AVC, and enterprise mobility solutions.
* Network Security — Expertise in Cisco ISE, ACLs, VPN (L2VPN, L3VPN, IPSEC, GRE), and advanced security architectures.
* Datacenter Networking — Deep experience with protocols and technologies such as BGP-Lite, VLAN, VxLAN, FCoE, TRILL, OTV, IS-IS, and datacenter fabrics.
* Virtualization — Hands-on experience with VMware, Hyper-V, and virtual networking solutions.
* Datacenter Projects — Experience in datacenter consolidation, transformation, and migration projects.
* Cloud Infrastructure — Knowledge and experience with cloud computing infrastructure, orchestration, and hybrid networking.
* Software Defined Networking — Strong understanding of SDN and NFV technologies, including deployment and operational support.
* Automation & Scripting — Practical experience with automation frameworks (Python, Ansible, REST APIs, Terraform) for configuration, compliance, and workflow optimization.
* Observability & Monitoring — Exposure to observability platforms (DNAC, SolarWinds, Splunk, Prometheus, AIOps tools) for proactive monitoring and predictive insights.
* AI/ML in Networking — Experience leveraging AI/ML-driven tools for anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and performance optimization.
* Proficiency in network monitoring tools ( SolarWinds, DNAC, Prime, Splunk, etc.)
* Collaboration & Leadership — Demonstrated ability to work with global IT teams, OEMs, vendors, partners, and service providers, and act as SPOC for transition, transformation, and greenfield/brownfield projects. Ability to lead technical discussions with customers and stakeholders.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.
* Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.
* Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Operate and continuously improve the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.
* Design and provision GCP infrastructure using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.
* Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.
* Implement observability and operational insight using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.
* Apply ITSM practices across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.
* Act as a senior escalation point for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Establish standards and governance for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.
* Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.
* GCP — primary requirement: Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.
* Terraform — primary engineering keyword: Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.
* Scripting and automation: Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.
* Web and application infrastructure: Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Observability: Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.
* ITSM and operations: Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.
* Systems and troubleshooting: Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.

title: Information Security Engineer
description:
The Information Security team at IMC Trading is responsible for protecting IMC's intellectual property, IT infrastructure and business operations against external and internal threats. We work closely with technology, risk, compliance, internal audit and business leaders to reduce cyber risk to acceptable levels.
  
  
We are looking for an Information Security Engineer to help grow and mature our Security Operations Centre, which runs on EDR, SIEM, SOAR, CSPM, IAM, firewalls, NIDS/NIPS and a range of other security controls. Alongside SOC work, you will play a central role in supporting IMC's regulatory obligations in India, preparing evidence and coordinating the cyber and systems audits that come with operating in this market.
  
  
We offer an environment that lets you broaden and deepen your information security knowledge, with access to advanced security technology, frequent training and a culture of knowledge sharing. As you gain experience with our existing SOC technology and processes, you will be given considerable freedom to mature the function through your own initiatives.
  
  
**Your Core Responsibilities**

* Analyse security logs, alerts and reported events, and respond to or assist with the remediation of incidents.
* Hunt for potential compromise across the infrastructure using a range of threat intelligence sources.
* Report discovered vulnerabilities to technology owners and recommend remediation steps.
* Support and improve technical security controls.
* Leverage automation and orchestration to remove repetitive manual work.
* Apply AI-assisted tooling to alert triage, event summarisation and investigation workflows, with a pragmatic view of its limitations.
* Develop reporting that measures the effectiveness of security controls.
* Develop and improve incident response playbooks.
* Support regulatory and assurance audits: prepare evidence, coordinate with auditors and track observations through to closure.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* A self-starter with a genuine passion for cybersecurity.
* Previous SOC experience, and/or 3+ years of hands-on experience in an enterprise IT environment managing endpoints and applications on-premises or in the cloud.
* Exposure to security controls such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, and endpoint detection and response.
* Working knowledge of — or a strong willingness to learn — the Indian regulatory cybersecurity landscape: SEBI CSCRF, exchange circulars (NSE/BSE/MCX) and CERT-In directions, along with familiarity with ISO 27001 and the NIST CSF on which CSCRF is modelled.
* Experience supporting audits (cyber audit, systems audit, VAPT, ISO or SOC 2 assessments) — evidence preparation, auditor coordination and observation remediation — is a strong plus.
* Automation using basic coding skills or low-code / no-code tools.
* Awareness of AI and machine learning applications in security operations is a plus; hands-on experience with AI-assisted security tooling or LLM-based workflows is highly regarded.
* Understanding of common attack techniques and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
* Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into audit-ready evidence and regulator-facing reports.
* Relevant tertiary and/or security qualifications are a plus — for example a Bachelor's degree in information systems or computer science, CompTIA Security+, Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), CEH, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer. If you don't have them yet, you will be supported to pursue certifications on the job.

**About Us**
*IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: IT & Security Operations Lead
description:
**Who We Are**

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. We turn the primary sources of Indian law, from the BNS, BNSS and BSA to decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, into something any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes.

India has more than 55 million pending cases, and the outcome for a litigant can turn on who they can afford. We're building the foundation that gives an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

**Why This Role Matters**

Today we run on Microsoft 365 and Slack with no central identity platform, no device management baseline, no formal service desk, and no security framework. There is no Active Directory. This is not a role that inherits a mature estate and governs it.

This is a build role first and a governance role second. In your first year you'll design and stand up the identity, endpoint, network and security foundations for the whole group, and then run them well. You'll have one engineer working to you from day one, real budget, and a direct line to the CTO. You'll also be hands-on: at our size, the person who designs conditional access is the same person who occasionally re-images a laptop.

**What You'll Own**

* Identity & access: Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory as the group's authoritative identity source. SSO, MFA, conditional access, RBAC, privileged access, joiner-mover-leaver, and periodic access reviews.
* Microsoft 365: Tenant administration and governance, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing optimisation, multi-entity and multi-domain design, and security baselines.
* Slack: End-to-end administration (Teams chat is deliberately disabled). SSO and SCIM from Entra ID, retention and eDiscovery, DLP, app approval, and guest governance.
* Endpoint management: A mixed Windows and macOS fleet of roughly 100 devices. Intune, Apple Business Manager with zero-touch enrolment, FileVault escrow, and a macOS patching approach of your recommendation.
* Security operations: SPF, DKIM and DMARC across all domains, endpoint protection, vulnerability posture, phishing simulation and awareness training, shadow-IT discovery, secrets hygiene, and an incident response runbook you've actually rehearsed.
* Compliance & audit: IT controls evidence for SOC 2, IT's obligations under India's DPDP Act including breach notification readiness, the asset register, e-waste rules, and access control and CCTV administration.
* Infrastructure & network: Firewall, VPN, Wi-Fi and ISPs, the new Mumbai office comms room and cabling handover, and the physical environment for on-premises GPU infrastructure (power, cooling, access, encryption at rest).
* Backup, DR & continuity: Backup standards, defined recovery objectives, restores tested on a schedule, and documented continuity procedures.
* Service management: Select and run our first ticketing system, publish SLAs, direct the Network & Helpdesk Engineer's work, and own major incident escalation.
* Vendors & budget: Microsoft partners, ISPs, hardware and SaaS vendors. Contracts, renewals, endpoint procurement, vendor security reviews, and input into the annual IT budget.

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

We'll judge this role on outcomes, not activity. By the end of your first twelve months we expect:

* Identity is authoritative: Entra ID and Active Directory deployed, everyone provisioned from a single source, and SSO live for our top applications including Slack
* MFA and conditional access at 100%: No exceptions without a documented, time-bound approval
* Every device managed: 100% of Windows and macOS endpoints enrolled, encrypted, patch-compliant and in a single inventory
* Joiner-mover-leaver is a process, not a favour: Documented, measured against an SLA, with offboarding that reliably revokes access on the day it should
* A service desk exists: Ticketing live, SLAs published, and a baseline satisfaction measure
* Recovery is proven, not assumed: At least one full documented restore test for each critical system
* Audit-ready: SOC 2 IT evidence produced on a defined schedule, and DPDP obligations mapped to owners
* The estate is documented: Asset register, network documentation, and runbooks your engineer can work from without you

**Scope Boundary**

* You own corporate IT: identity, endpoints, the corporate network, SaaS, and the physical technology environment, including power, cooling, access control and encryption for our on-premises GPU hardware.
* Engineering owns production cloud infrastructure, the build and deployment pipeline, and the product environment. You're consulted on those and own identity and access into them, but you're not the approver for production change.
* Where the boundary is genuinely unclear, raise it rather than either annexing or ignoring it.

**What You Bring**

* You've personally built a Microsoft identity platform from nothing, with Entra ID and Active Directory designed, deployed and cut over, not just administered one someone else built
* Deep, hands-on Microsoft 365 tenant administration: Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing, security baselines and conditional access
* Real endpoint management across Windows and macOS, including Intune and Apple Business Manager, and opinions about managing Macs properly
* You've carried SOC 2, ISO 27001 or an equivalent framework as the person who produced the IT evidence, not a bystander to the audit
* Comfortable being hands-on and hands-off in the same day: architecture in the morning, a stuck user in the afternoon, without resenting either
* You can lead one engineer well: allocate work, review it honestly, and grow them
* Patience with non-technical users in a trading business and a biotech who don't think in tickets

**Bonus Points**

* Slack administration at organisation scale: SCIM, retention, DLP, eDiscovery, app governance
* Multi-entity or multi-company tenant design, including data segregation and per-entity licensing and cost allocation
* Familiarity with India's DPDP Act as it applies to IT operations
* Commissioning a new office: comms room, structured cabling, access control and CCTV integration
* Exposure to on-premises GPU or high-density compute environments
* Working fluency in Hindi or Marathi alongside English

**What You Get**

* A true build opportunity: design the group's identity, endpoint, network and security foundations from scratch
* One engineer working to you from day one, and real budget
* A direct line to the CTO
* Group-wide scope across trading, biotech and legal tech, including the infrastructure behind India's agentic legal AI

GIS Identity & Access management (IAM) Access Control Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.
  
  
**Job Description**
In support of the Cloud Security program and the delivery of an operational framework, the role requires hands-on knowledge and experience with the policies, tools, configurations, and rules needed to deploy solutions that manage the security of cloud platforms and reduce risk to bank workloads in the cloud.
  
  
The role supports the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for IAM controls in cloud environments and help drive implementation of the designed control environment. This includes developing cloud IAM requirements based on threat models, laws, rules, and regulations, driving related updates to Policy, Standards, and Baselines, and assessing operational readiness of process and technical capabilities to implement the required controls.
  
  
The successful analyst is result-oriented and business-focused, and succeeds at interfacing across multiple organizational units at various levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Ensure IAM technology and controls for cloud are implemented, monitored, and adhered to established IAM standards.
* Achieve intended cloud IAM outcomes through the development and enhancement of applicable standards, processes, data elements, oversight, and governance for the bank’s cloud infrastructure, systems, and applications.
* Develop cloud IAM requirements based on threat models, laws, rules, and regulations, and drive related updates to Policy, Standards, and Baselines.
* Assess operational readiness of process and technical capabilities to implement required controls; determine whether existing or proposed controls satisfy policy, regulatory, and control requirements.
* Appropriately assess risk when business and technology decisions are made, demonstrating a risk management mindset to safeguard the bank’s reputation, clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations and adhering to Policy and Standards.
* Apply industry IAM best practices, templates, and documentation, while proposing improvements based on practical knowledge.
* Influence technology and platform owners to build and implement necessary IAM controls into cloud environments to create a smooth and effective cloud IAM adoption experience.
* Engage with Product Managers and Senior Architects to understand the strategic technology roadmap and the resulting need for modernized security principles.
* Consult with the business to identify gaps and governance issues, leveraging domain expertise to find effective solutions.
* Provide IAM subject matter expertise within the business and technical domain to support scope and requirement decisions.
* Perform impact analysis of modifications or enhancements, working closely with development teams to refine requirements into implementable specifications.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations through comprehensive UAT/QA testing of functionality and quality, and confirm the delivery timeline and adoption plan are fit for purpose.
* Create required documentation, playbooks, job aides, workflows, and training material as part of deployment and adoption activities.
* Support the design and update of new and existing controls, including the streamlining and automation of reporting.
* Develop and maintain documentation that accurately describes the current cloud IAM control environment for review by oversight organizations (Audit, Compliance, Operational Risk, Regulators).

**Requirements**

* Education

BE/BTECH/MCA/MSC (IT) equivalent (Any Technical Degree)
  
  

* Certifications If Any

NA

title: Cyber Security Architect
description:
**Job Description: WAAP Platform Engineer**

**The role**

The WAAP Platform Engineer provides engineering leadership for HSBC’s Web Application and API Protection capability across multiple platforms and thousands of applications. The role translates capability strategy and cyber architecture into actionable engineering artefacts, platform standards, reusable templates, guardrails, and implementation guidance.

Working closely with Cyber Architecture, the WAAP Capability Owner, Engineering, and Operations, the role ensures platform designs and controls are robust, scalable, supportable, and aligned with HSBC security and compliance requirements. It also evaluates non-standard business requirements, provides product-focused technical guidance, and ensures deviations are appropriately risk-assessed and documented.

The successful candidate will combine strong WAAP engineering expertise with effective stakeholder leadership. They will drive continuous improvement, discovery, and efficacy testing; connect capability and architecture intent with platform delivery; and establish structured feedback loops so that operational lessons, engineering challenges, and improvement opportunities are captured and acted upon.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engineering leadership for the WAAP capability: Act as a primary engineering lead, setting technical direction and promoting consistent engineering practices across the capability.
* Collaborate with Cyber Architecture and the WAAP Capability Owner to translate strategy, target-state architecture, control requirements, and product priorities into actionable engineering artefacts and delivery plans.
* Platform standards, templates, and guardrails: Partner with Operations to define and maintain platform standards, reference patterns, reusable engineering templates, configuration baselines, and guardrails for the seven Cyber-supported WAAP solutions.
* Ensure engineering artefacts are secure, robust, scalable, automatable, supportable, and aligned with HSBC security, risk, and compliance requirements.
* Business engagement for non-standard solutions: Engage business and technology stakeholders to assess requirements that fall outside approved patterns or standard platform capabilities.
* Provide technical options and product guidance, challenge unnecessary variation, and ensure approved deviations are risk-assessed, documented, governed, and traceable.
* Continuous improvement, discovery, and efficacy testing: Identify opportunities for new or enhanced WAAP functions, controls, automation, and operating practices.
* Lead technical discovery, proofs of concept, and efficacy testing for platform capabilities, managed and custom controls, and emerging protection requirements.
* Drive innovation, engineering quality, and delivery efficiency while keeping pace with evolving cyber threats, technology changes, and business needs.
* Feedback loops across capability, architecture, platform, and operations: Provide structured feedback to Capability and Architecture teams so lessons learned, control gaps, and improvement opportunities inform roadmaps and design decisions.
* Work with Engineering and Operations teams to understand delivery and support challenges, prioritize improvements, and provide clear product and engineering leadership through implementation and lifecycle management.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Own the quality, consistency, and technical integrity of engineering outputs for the WAAP capability.
* Produce and maintain engineering standards, reference designs, patterns, configuration baselines, decision records, and implementation guidance.
* Ensure requirements and architecture decisions are translated into deliverable, testable, and operationally sustainable solutions.
* Define acceptance criteria and evidence for platform controls, including functional, security, resilience, performance, and efficacy outcomes.
* Promote automation and repeatability through infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, APIs, and CI/CD integration where appropriate.
* Assess non-standard designs and exceptions, documenting technical rationale, risks, compensating controls, ownership, and remediation or exit plans.
* Coordinate technical discovery and evaluation of new WAAP capabilities, product features, and vendor solutions.
* Use operational telemetry, incidents, tuning outcomes, engineering feedback, and threat intelligence to identify and prioritize platform improvements.
* Facilitate design reviews and technical forums, communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support the WAAP roadmap by identifying dependencies, technical debt, lifecycle risks, and opportunities to simplify or consolidate the platform estate.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Demonstrable experience engineering enterprise WAAP, WAF, API security, bot management, DDoS protection, or related application-edge security platforms.
* Experience providing technical leadership across complex, multi-platform environments and translating strategy and architecture into implementable engineering outcomes.
* Strong understanding of web and API protocols, modern application architectures, common attack techniques, and layered mitigation strategies.
* Practical experience defining platform standards, reusable patterns, configuration baselines, guardrails, and technical documentation.
* Experience with several major WAAP or WAF technologies, such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Akamai, F5, Cloudflare, and an understanding of their deployment and operating models.
* Knowledge of cloud, network, application delivery, identity, observability, resilience, and DevSecOps principles relevant to WAAP services.
* Experience with automation, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, source control, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to design and execute proofs of concept, control validation, and efficacy testing, and to turn results into clear engineering recommendations.
* Sound risk judgement with experience assessing exceptions, documenting technical decisions, and working within security, compliance, and governance frameworks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance security outcomes, business needs, operability, cost, and delivery constraints.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence architecture, capability, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders.
* A collaborative, outcome-focused approach and a commitment to continuous learning, service improvement, and engineering excellence.

* Proofpoint Email Protection

* Secure Email Gateway Architecture
* DNS & MX Routing Design

* PowerShell Scripting

* Phishing Protection
* Malware Analysis
* Threat Hunting
* Email Security Architecture
* Incident Response
* Data Loss Prevention

**Monitoring & Analytics**

* Splunk
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Defender for Office 365
* SIEM Correlation

* 4+ years of hands-on Proofpoint administration and engineering.

title: Splunk Engineer
description:

**Splunk Engineer**

  (Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.).
* Experience with
  **SPL.**
* Proficiency in
  **scripting languages**
  such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Experience onboarding structured and unstructured data from various sources.

* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team.

title: Program Analyst, Privacy/AI Governance/Cyber Advisory
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Program Analyst, Privacy/AI Governance/Cyber Advisory**
Our People & Culture and Legal teams make sure we provide a highly ethical working environment where everyone at Priceline can bring their whole selves to work and deliver their very best each day. We want you to thrive – to feel safe, supported, valued, and growing to your highest potential!
  
  
**Why Is This Job a Big Deal**
The position is responsible for coordinating Governance, Risk & Control (“GRC”) processes as part of the Privacy/AI Governance and Cyber Advisory team at Priceline. This role requires an understanding of our existing personal data processing environment and infrastructure, controls and risk profile. It also requires an understanding of the company’s innovative utilization of AI technology to serve our customers and our own productivity in an ethical, responsible and trustworthy manner.
  
  
The Analyst will be part of a high-performing and diverse privacy team at Priceline, a US subsidiary of the biggest online travel company of the world. He/she will be part of a dynamic, responsive team that has multiple exciting challenges.
  
  
**In This Role You Will Get To**

* Coordinate end-to-end privacy GRC projects and initiatives to improve our compliance & risk posture.
* Mature and maintain our current NIST-P framework and support our analysis of NIST-AI (or similar framework) for adoption, enhancing the frameworks and controls based on recommendations from maturity and risk assessments.
* Monitor control performance across the business for timely and effective execution.
* Assistance in executing risk assessments and providing support as necessary to our third-party risk assurance process.
* Adoption, maintenance and enhancement of our GRC tools.
* Maintain and improve our policy framework, in accordance with our regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Track progress of issues reported, gaps/risks identified, and support in the creation of dashboards and metrics to oversee mitigation.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the Company, such as Security, Technology, Data, Marketing and People & Culture.
* Act as a privacy & AI champion.
* Perform other duties as requested.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 3 years of experience working in a privacy or data protection GRC function
* BIG4 experience is a plus.
* Experience coordinating an external NIST audit is a plus.
* One or more industry-standard privacy professional certifications, such as AIGC, CIPP-M, CIPP-E or CIPP-US
* Knowledge of control and compliance frameworks, e.g. NIST-P, NIST-AI, NIST-CSF
* Basic understanding of privacy and security by design, responsible AI development and engineering best practices.
* Experience driving GRC initiatives in a proactive and independent manner.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in fast-paced environments.
* Solid problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Experience and solid skills in working with AI enterprise platforms and tooling, e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to priceline.com: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
  
  
**Financial security programs**
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

**L2 Linux & Database Support Engineer**
to manage, maintain, and optimize our enterprise Linux operating systems and database environments. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Linux administration, hands-on database operations (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MS SQL), patching, backup management, and preventive maintenance. You will serve as an escalation point for infrastructure and application incidents, ensuring maximum uptime, security compliance, and strict SLA adherence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Linux OS Administration & Troubleshooting**

* Provide L2-level administration, configuration, and troubleshooting for enterprise Linux operating systems (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, SuSE).
* Perform continuous system monitoring, performance tuning, kernel parameter updates, disk management (LVM), and log analysis.
* Implement server hardening, user management, SSH security, and security best practices across Linux servers.
* Database Operational Administration & Maintenance
* Execute day-to-day database administration, monitoring, maintenance, and health checks (Oracle / PostgreSQL / MySQL / MS SQL).
* Conduct regular database health reporting, index maintenance, tablespace management, and query performance checks.
* Oversee database patching, version updates, and vulnerability remediation in coordination with application teams.
* Backup, Storage & Infrastructure Support
* Coordinate, execute, and troubleshoot database backups (RMAN, pg\_dump, mysqldump, or enterprise backup tools) and perform periodic restoration test runs.
* Provide cross-functional support across server hardware, NAS/SAN storage, basic network configurations, and security devices.
* Conduct preventive maintenance, proactive health checks, and capacity planning for Linux and database platforms.
* Incident Management & OEM / Vendor Escalation
* Resolve complex L2 incidents, service requests, and problem tickets within defined SLA targets.
* Lead end-to-end technical escalations and vendor coordination with OEMs (e.g., Red Hat, Oracle, hardware vendors) and application developers to resolve critical technical issues or software bugs.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major system or database outages and document permanent fixes.
* Application Support & Compliance
* Assist application support teams with database connectivity, environment readiness, deployment support, and troubleshooting.
* Implement OS patching, security updates, and vulnerability remediation to maintain security compliance.
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational logs.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in Linux administration and database support in enterprise environments.
* Linux Expertise: Advanced knowledge of RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu, shell scripting (Bash/Python), systemd, LVM, user/permission management, and networking configurations.
* Database Management: Working knowledge of database administration (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server) including backup/restore, user management, and performance monitoring.
* Security & Patching: Demonstrated experience in automated/manual OS & database patching, vulnerability scanning tool remediation, and system hardening.
* Backup & Recovery: Practical knowledge of enterprise backup tools (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, RMAN) and DR procedures.
* Vendor & SLA Management: Experience coordinating with hardware/software vendors, managing high-severity escalations, and operating within an ITIL incident management framework.

**Preferred Certifications (Plus)**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) / Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Database Certifications (e.g., Oracle Certified Associate/Professional, PostgreSQL Certified Engineer).
* ITIL Foundation certification.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Job Description: Cloud Security Engineer
  
  
Reports to: Security Lead
  
  
Level: Mid (IC)
  
  
Mission
  
  
Own the identity, access, and network security control plane — CyberArk, Zscaler and Cloudflare — for a fast-scaling, AI-driven insurance infrastructure org. You'll take these tools from initial deployment handoff to steady, auditable, day-2 operations, and be the technical backbone the Security Lead relies on for privileged access and network security posture.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  

* CyberArk (PAM) — safe/policy design, privileged account lifecycle, credential rotation monitoring, access recertification
* Zscaler (SSE) — policy tuning, app onboarding, exception handling
* Cloudflare (WAF/CDN, and Zero Trust/Access if applicable) — rule tuning, DNS, edge security posture

Key responsibilities
  
  

* Take over day-2 administration of CyberArk from the implementation partner; ensure clean runbooks/SOPs exist and are maintained
* Run privileged access onboarding/offboarding and periodic access recertification, feeding evidence to the GRC Analyst for audit cycles
* Own Zscaler and Cloudflare policy baselines; manage exceptions without degrading security posture
* Partner with engineering teams as headcount scales to keep IAM and network controls usable, not just secure
* Support technical deep-dives requested by auditors or pen testers on identity/network architecture
* Identify opportunities to automate policy-drift detection and routine PAM/SSE administration, in line with the team's AI-driven, lean operating model
* Escalate control-design questions or audit findings on these tools to the Security Lead

What we're looking for
  
  

* 3–6+ years in security engineering, with hands-on ownership of at least one PAM platform (CyberArk strongly preferred) in production
* Working experience with a cloud SSE/ZTNA platform (Zscaler, Cloudflare Access, or similar) and a CDN/WAF
* Comfortable being the sole owner of high-scrutiny controls in an audited environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar)
* Strong scripting/automation ability (Python, Terraform, or similar) to keep a lean team's operational load sustainable
* Clear written communication — you'll produce evidence and explanations auditors and pen testers can follow

Nice to have
  
  

* Insurance, financial services, or other regulated-industry background
* Experience standing up or maturing a PAM program from a fresh implementation
* Exposure to NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law or similar state insurance regulatory frameworks

How we'll know you're succeeding
  
  

* CyberArk, Zscaler, and Cloudflare pass audit control tests with minimal findings
* Privileged access recertification completed on schedule every cycle
* No unplanned production impact from policy changes across owned tools
* Routine administration increasingly automated rather than manual quarter over quarter

title: Operational Risk, Assistant Manager
description:
Role Summary
  
  
State Street uses third parties to support internal processes and the delivery of products and services to clients. These relationships are evaluated and risk-assessed through the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Program.
  
  
The Third-Party Risk Management Associate will support the effective execution of activities across one or more TPRM lifecycle pillars. Depending on business requirements, the role may include reviewing TPRM cases and engagement records, reviewing and challenging inherent risk assessments, coordinating supplier due diligence outreach, monitoring and reviewing due diligence submissions, preparing executive summaries, and managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will apply sound risk judgement, identify and resolve data or process inconsistencies, maintain complete and accurate records, and communicate TPRM requirements and assessment outcomes clearly. The role requires close collaboration with Engagement Managers, third-party suppliers, risk-domain subject matter experts, Business Advisors, Procurement, Legal, and TPRM teams to support timely, consistent, policy-aligned, and audit-ready outcomes.
  
  
**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of State Street’s business lines, products and services, third-party operating model, and TPRM lifecycle requirements.
* Review and evaluate TPRM SNOW cases, Archer engagement records, assessment records, and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable policies, standards and procedures
* Manage assigned case queues, review and effectively challenge TPRM cases and support business lines in faster onboarding of third-party suppliers.
* Identify inconsistencies or gaps in inherent risk questionnaire responses and work with Engagement Managers and relevant stakeholders to resolve issues before approval.
* Apply knowledge of inherent risk questionnaire logic, scoring, question interdependencies, and due diligence triggers to confirm that the resulting inherent risk rating and due diligence requirements are appropriate.
* Prepare and distribute due diligence questionnaires and supporting requirements to third-party suppliers or internal service providers within established timelines.
* Monitor due diligence progress, perform follow-ups and escalations, and maintain clear records of outreach, responses, decisions, and outstanding actions.
* Perform completeness and quality reviews of returned due diligence questionnaires and supporting artifacts before routing the assessment to the appropriate risk-domain subject matter experts.
* Coordinate follow-up questions, clarification discussions, and supplier meetings; track responses and facilitate resolution of outstanding items.
* Review and analyze due diligence results, assessment conclusions, control-effectiveness ratings, and identified findings to confirm that outcomes are sufficiently supported and accurately documented.
* Prepare clear, concise, and audit-ready executive summaries that communicate the engagement scope, inherent risk profile, due diligence results, control effectiveness, findings, residual concerns, and required acknowledgement or next steps.
* Coordinate executive-summary review and issuance with Engagement Managers, Executive Sponsors, Business Advisors, risk-domain subject matter experts, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with third-party suppliers, Engagement Managers, business stakeholders, Procurement, Legal, risk-domain subject matter experts, and TPRM partner teams.
* Explain TPRM requirements, risk-analysis conclusions, findings, and remediation expectations clearly and professionally, and guide stakeholders toward timely resolution.
* Ensure that TPRM decisions, approvals, exceptions, and supporting evidence are accurately captured in Archer and relevant repositories to support governance, audit, and regulatory review.
* Support the preparation of management information, metrics, trend analysis, and status reporting for TPRM leadership and governance forums.
* Maintain and enhance procedures, checklists, templates, job aids, frequently asked questions, and other process documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, data quality, control effectiveness, stakeholder experience, and consistency of TPRM outcomes.
* Participate in system testing, process-change initiatives, remediation programmes, quality-assurance reviews, audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Maintain flexibility to work across TPRM pillars and support emerging programmed priorities arising from business, regulatory, policy, technology, or operating-model changes.
* Perform all responsibilities in accordance with State Street’s risk appetite, policies, standards, ethical requirements, and control expectations.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of third-party risk management principles, lifecycle activities, and governance requirements within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Sound risk judgement and the ability to assess the reasonableness, completeness, and consistency of information and supporting evidence.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify gaps, challenge assumptions, and develop practical resolution paths.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong stakeholder and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes while maintaining professional and constructive working relationships.
* Ability to manage multiple cases, competing priorities, and tight deadlines in a high-volume, control-focused environment.
* Strong organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with close attention to detail.
* Strong customer-centric mindset and commitment to providing clear guidance and responsive support to business and supplier stakeholders.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and related reporting tools.
* Working knowledge of Archer or a comparable governance, risk, and compliance platform is preferred.
* High ethical standards, professional integrity, and commitment to maintaining appropriate confidentiality.

**Qualifications**

* Overall professional experience of 7 or more years, preferably within banking, financial services, risk management, compliance, procurement, audit, controls, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in Third-Party Risk Management, operational risk, supplier risk, vendor management, due diligence, or another risk-and-control function.
* Practical experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: TPRM case review, inherent risk assessment, due diligence outreach and completeness review, risk assessment coordination, findings management, executive-summary preparation, or stakeholder relationship management.
* General knowledge of third-party risk domains, including Operational Resiliency, Operational Risk, Cybersecurity, Information Sensitivity and Access, Privacy, Physical Security, Reputational Risk, Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Bribery and Corruption, Financial Viability, and Tax Evasion.
* Experience working with internal stakeholders, third-party suppliers, and subject matter experts in a matrixed and globally distributed organization.
* Experience preparing management reporting, governance materials, executive communications, audit evidence, or regulatory-response documentation is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in business or a postgraduate management qualification is preferred.
* Relevant professional certification such as CRVPM, CRISC, CISM, CISA, CBCI, or an equivalent risk-management qualification is advantageous.
* Prior experience with Archer or a comparable governance, risk, and compliance platform is preferred.
* Please note: The role is required to support internal clients during the first half of US working hours.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
  
  
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

**Network Security Engineer**

* Network Security Operations: Support traditional network security controls including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), intrusion prevention systems (IPS), and secure web gateways.
* Operations & Troubleshooting: Serve as the escalation point for complex network security issues, utilizing packet capture tools (Wireshark) to diagnose connectivity and performance anomalies.

* Must be available to join immediately or within a 30-day notice period.

* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA) or Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP).

**What We Offer**

* Hybrid work flexibility balancing collaborative in-office days with focused remote work.
* Direct exposure to enterprise-scale cloud security migrations.
* Competitive compensation and clear technical career progression.

title: Data Privacy Consultant
description:
**Company:**
ComplyZen Security Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (Mumbai locals preferred)

**Work Mode:**
Remote, with client site visits as required

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Travel Requirement:**
Occasional travel to client locations, primarily as required for consulting engagements

About ComplyZen

ComplyZen Security Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a RegTech company focused on simplifying Governance, Risk, Compliance (GRC), cybersecurity, and data privacy for startups, MSMEs, and enterprises. Through its compliance management platforms and consulting services, ComplyZen helps organizations streamline compliance activities, manage risks, improve operational efficiency, and maintain audit readiness.

ComplyZen supports organizations in implementing and maintaining regulatory and industry frameworks, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and other applicable security and privacy requirements. Our goal is to make compliance practical, accessible, and affordable through technology-enabled solutions and expert consulting.

About the Role

ComplyZen is seeking a
**Data Privacy Consultant**
based in Mumbai to support client engagements involving data privacy compliance, privacy risk assessments, regulatory gap analysis, documentation, and implementation of privacy controls.

This is a remote-first role. However, the candidate must be willing and available to visit client offices when required for stakeholder discussions, assessments, workshops, implementation support, and compliance reviews.

The consultant will work closely with clients and ComplyZen's internal consulting, product, and information security teams to translate regulatory requirements into practical, implementable privacy controls. The role requires strong analytical skills, regulatory awareness, documentation capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple client engagements independently.

Key Responsibilities1. Data Privacy Compliance and Assessments

* Conduct privacy compliance assessments, regulatory gap analyses, and data protection maturity reviews.
* Support client readiness assessments for India's DPDPA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other applicable privacy regulations.
* Identify compliance gaps, assess privacy risks, and develop practical remediation plans.
* Assist in identifying applicable regulatory obligations based on client business activities, geography, and data processing practices.

2. Privacy Documentation and Governance

* Draft, review, and maintain privacy notices, privacy policies, data retention and deletion procedures, data handling guidelines, and internal privacy standards.
* Support the preparation and maintenance of Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), data inventories, data flow documentation, and data classification records.
* Assist with Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), privacy impact assessments, and legitimate-interest or other relevant assessments where applicable.
* Review data processing agreements, vendor privacy requirements, consent documentation, and data subject request procedures.
* Support the development of privacy governance frameworks, roles, responsibilities, and operating procedures.

3. Implementation and Risk Management

* Help clients implement privacy controls and address identified compliance gaps.
* Coordinate with IT, information security, legal, HR, business, and vendor management teams to operationalize privacy requirements.
* Support third-party privacy risk assessments and reviews of cloud-based and SaaS environments.
* Assist with privacy incident response procedures, breach assessment workflows, escalation processes, and regulatory notification readiness.
* Track remediation activities and maintain evidence of compliance.

4. Client Engagement and Site Visits

* Conduct remote client meetings, stakeholder interviews, and compliance workshops.
* Visit client locations in Mumbai and other agreed locations, as required by project scope.
* Facilitate onsite assessments, evidence collection, awareness sessions, and implementation reviews.
* Present assessment findings, explain regulatory requirements, and communicate actionable recommendations to client stakeholders.
* Manage assigned engagements, deliverables, timelines, and client communications independently.

5. Compliance Platform and Internal Collaboration

* Use ComplyZen's compliance management platform to track assessments, risks, policies, controls, evidence, and remediation activities.
* Work with internal product and security teams to improve compliance workflows, framework mappings, templates, and reporting.
* Support the creation and maintenance of reusable assessment questionnaires, privacy templates, implementation guides, and client deliverables.
* Monitor relevant regulatory developments and help translate changes into practical client guidance.
* Contribute to internal knowledge management and continuous improvement of consulting methodologies.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Information Security, Computer Science, IT, Business, or a related discipline.
* Practical knowledge of data privacy, data protection principles, privacy governance, and regulatory compliance.
* Familiarity with India's DPDPA and GDPR; working knowledge of CCPA/CPRA or other international privacy regulations is an advantage.
* Experience in privacy assessments, regulatory gap analysis, privacy documentation, risk assessments, audits, or compliance implementation.
* Ability to develop and review privacy policies, notices, data retention procedures, data processing documentation, and privacy controls.
* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, information security controls, third-party risk, cloud environments, and SaaS security.
* Strong documentation, analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and work independently in a remote environment.
* Willingness to travel to client locations when required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Approximately 2–5 years of relevant experience in data privacy, privacy consulting, information security GRC, or regulatory compliance.
* Experience supporting DPDPA or GDPR implementation projects.
* Familiarity with DPIAs, RoPA, DSAR processes, consent management, vendor assessments, and privacy incident management.
* Knowledge of ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2, or related security and privacy frameworks.
* Relevant certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPP/A, CIPM, CIPT, ISO 27701, or equivalent qualifications are an advantage.
* Experience working with GRC, privacy management, or compliance automation platforms is desirable.

Work Location and Travel Conditions

* The candidate must be based in
  **Mumbai, Maharashtra**
  , and available to attend client meetings in person when required.
* The role is remote-first; daily office attendance is not required.
* Client site visits will depend on project requirements, assessment schedules, and client commitments.
* Travel outside Mumbai may occasionally be required, subject to project needs and prior coordination.
* Travel and expense reimbursement arrangements will follow ComplyZen's applicable company policy.

What We Offer

* An opportunity to work on real-world privacy and regulatory compliance engagements.
* Exposure to DPDPA, GDPR, international privacy requirements, and information security frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with a technology-enabled GRC and privacy compliance platform.
* Opportunities to contribute to consulting methodologies, compliance solutions, and product improvements.
* A collaborative, remote-first working environment with opportunities for professional growth.

  .

title: Senior SAP Basis Consultant – Technical Audit
description:
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra

Experience: 10+ Years

Project Duration: 3–4 Weeks

Engagement Type: Short-Term Contract / Project-Based

Joining: Immediate joiner

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior SAP Basis Consultant for a short-term project involving a technical audit of an enterprise SAP landscape. The consultant will assess the existing SAP infrastructure, system configurations, security controls and disaster recovery readiness, and provide actionable recommendations aligned with SAP best practices.

Key Responsibilities

\* Review the SAP landscape, architecture and technical configurations.

\* Assess SAP S/4HANA 1909, SAP Solution Manager 7.2, SAP BW/4HANA 2.0, SAP Fiori and SAP BusinessObjects environments.

\* Review SAP user roles, authorizations and privileged access.

\* Assess system logging, audit trails and monitoring mechanisms.

\* Review High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), replication and switchover procedures.

\* Evaluate transport management and change management processes across Development, Quality and Production environments.

\* Review critical SAP technical parameters, including RZ10, dialog work processes, central services, ICM and gateway configurations.

\* Assess SAP Security Notes, patch levels, security parameters and system hardening.

\* Identify technical gaps, security risks and deviations from SAP best practices.

\* Prepare a comprehensive audit report with supporting evidence, risk ratings and remediation recommendations.

\* Coordinate with technical stakeholders to validate findings and present the final assessment.

Required Skills & Experience

\* 10+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Basis administration.

\* Strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver and SAP HANA.

\* Experience with SAP upgrades, patching, performance tuning and system administration.

\* Strong understanding of SAP security, roles and authorizations.

\* Experience with HANA replication, HA/DR configurations and disaster recovery procedures.

\* Knowledge of SAP transport and change management.

\* Hands-on understanding of SAP technical parameters, ICM, gateway and central services.

\* Experience reviewing SAP Security Notes and technical configurations.

\* Strong audit documentation, analytical and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

\* SAP certifications in Basis, HANA or System Administration.

\* Previous experience conducting SAP technical audits or security assessments.

\* Exposure to Red Hat Linux, Sybase and hybrid/on-premises infrastructure.

\* Experience with SAP BW/4HANA, Fiori and BusinessObjects.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Job Title:**
System Administrator

**Department:**
IT

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on System Administrator to manage day-to-day IT infrastructure operations and end-user support. This role covers server administration support, CCTV/surveillance systems, desktop/laptop support, end-user application support, and printer/hardware troubleshooting. It's a broad, on-ground IT role ideal for someone who enjoys solving varied technical issues and keeping office IT running smoothly.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Server & Infrastructure Support**

* Assist in day-to-day administration and monitoring of Windows/Linux servers
* Support routine server maintenance tasks: patching, backups, user account management (under guidance of Senior SA)
* Monitor server health and escalate issues to senior team members as needed
* Maintain basic Active Directory tasks — user creation, password resets, group management

**CCTV & Surveillance Administration**

* Install, configure, and maintain CCTV cameras, DVR/NVR systems, and surveillance software
* Monitor camera uptime, storage capacity, and recording quality
* Troubleshoot CCTV connectivity, storage, and playback issues
* Coordinate with vendors for CCTV hardware repairs/replacements
* Manage access to surveillance footage as per company policy

**Desktop/Laptop Support**

* Provide first-level and second-level support for desktops, laptops, and peripherals
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot operating systems (Windows) and standard software
* Manage IT asset inventory — laptops, desktops, monitors, accessories
* Handle new employee IT onboarding (system setup) and offboarding (data wipe, asset recovery)
* Perform OS imaging, software installation, and system upgrades

**End-User Application Support**

* Provide support for standard business applications (MS Office, email/Outlook, VPN clients, ERP/SAP end-user issues, etc.)
* Troubleshoot login issues, application errors, and connectivity problems for end users
* Coordinate with application/software vendors for issue resolution
* Maintain and update user access for common business applications

**Printer & Hardware Support**

* Install, configure, and maintain printers, scanners, and other office hardware
* Troubleshoot printer connectivity, driver, and hardware issues
* Manage printer consumables (toner/cartridge) tracking and vendor coordination
* Maintain AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) records and coordinate vendor visits for hardware repairs

**Network & General IT Support**

* Support basic network troubleshooting (LAN connectivity, Wi-Fi, patch cords, switch ports)
* Assist in maintaining network cabling, patch panels, and rack organization
* Support video conferencing/meeting room IT equipment setup

**Documentation & Ticketing**

* Log, track, and resolve IT support tickets within defined SLAs
* Maintain accurate documentation of IT assets, configurations, and recurring issues
* Prepare and update SOPs for common support tasks

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in system administration / IT support / desktop support roles
* Working knowledge of Windows Server basics and Windows OS (10/11) troubleshooting
* Hands-on experience with CCTV systems (installation, configuration, troubleshooting)
* Good understanding of desktop/laptop hardware, printers, and peripheral troubleshooting
* Basic networking knowledge (LAN, Wi-Fi, IP configuration)
* Experience supporting end-user applications (MS Office, Outlook, basic ERP/SAP GUI issues)
* Ticketing tool experience (ServiceNow, Freshservice, or similar) preferred

**Preferred Certifications**

* CompTIA A+ / Network+
* Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Fundamentals / MD-100 (Windows Client)
* Any CCTV/surveillance vendor certification (Hikvision, CP Plus, Dahua, etc.) is a plus

**Soft Skills**

* Good communication and customer-service orientation (this is a user-facing role)
* Ability to prioritize and handle multiple support requests
* Willingness to do hands-on/physical work (hardware, cabling, on-site visits)
* Team player, comfortable working under the Senior SA's guidance

title: Lead Security Engineer
description:
All positionsLead Security Engineer EngineeringMumbai, IndiaFull-time Apply Now

**About the Role**

As Lead Security Engineer at IQWorks, you will own security for a platform whose entire promise is protecting sensitive data. Security is not a feature bolted on at the end here — it is the product, and you will be the person who holds the bar. You will own our zero-trust architecture and the strict data-isolation guarantees that keep every customer's data separate, and you will make sure those guarantees hold as the platform grows. You will threat-model new features, run security reviews on the code we ship, harden our cloud and on-premise deployments, and lead our response when something needs attention. You will stay hands-on — reading code, writing tooling, and fixing issues at the root — while setting the standards and secure-by-default patterns the whole engineering team builds around. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thinks like an attacker, builds like an engineer, and treats customer trust as the thing worth protecting.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the security posture of the IQWorks platform, from application code to infrastructure to on-premise deployments
* Guard the zero-trust data-isolation model — keep multi-tenant separation airtight and enforce least-privilege access end to end
* Threat-model new features and lead security reviews before they ship, working alongside the engineering team
* Build and automate security tooling — static and dynamic analysis, dependency and secret scanning, and CI security gates
* Run vulnerability management end to end: triage, prioritize, and drive fixes at the root cause
* Lead incident response — detection, containment, remediation, and blameless post-mortems
* Harden cloud and on-premise/edge environments so enterprises can process sensitive data without it leaving their infrastructure
* Support enterprise security reviews and our compliance and certification program (SOC 2, ISO 27001, and similar)
* Set secure-by-default patterns and raise the security bar across the team as the company scales

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5+ years in security engineering, application security, or software engineering with a heavy security focus
* Strong grasp of web application security — the OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, and secure application design
* Hands-on experience securing multi-tenant SaaS, including database-level access controls and data isolation
* Ability to read and write production code (TypeScript, and a backend language such as Go or Python) and fix issues yourself, not just file them
* Experience with threat modeling, security reviews, and vulnerability management in a shipping product
* Working knowledge of cloud security and hardening, and comfort reasoning about on-premise and edge deployments
* Effective use of AI as a force multiplier across the security workflow — reviewing code, triaging findings, and building tooling — with sharp judgment about where human oversight is essential so security is never compromised
* Clear communication and the ability to work directly with engineering, product, and founders in a fast-moving startup

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with database-enforced authorization and fine-grained access-control models
* Background in data privacy, compliance, or governance, and familiarity with regulations such as DPDPA, GDPR, or HIPAA
* Experience driving SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar certifications
* Security certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, or GIAC
* Experience securing AI/ML systems or LLM-based features against prompt injection and data-leakage risks
* Prior experience as an early security hire at a high-growth startup

**Apply Now**
