title: Product Manager – AI & Information Security
description:
**Product Manager – AI & Information Security**

Location: Mumbai Department: Product

**Our Purpose**

India is in the middle of an extraordinary AI revolution, powered by a young, tech-savvy generation and visionary leaders who see the future in code and creativity. Across industries—from healthcare to finance to education—AI adoption is accelerating rapidly, creating new opportunities for organizations to transform how they work, operate, and serve their customers.

At the heart of this movement stands Neysa, India’s trusted AI Acceleration Cloud Provider.

Neysa exists to democratize AI. Built in India for the world, Neysa combines deep expertise in AI infrastructure, cloud, and cybersecurity to help organizations confidently adopt, accelerate, govern, secure, and scale AI.

The Future of AI, Built on Trust and Expertise. Neysa is building the Home for Your AI.

**Who We Are**

Co-founded by industry pioneers Sharad Sanghi and Anindya Das, Neysa brings together deep expertise across AI, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity to build products for the next generation of technology adoption.

Its flagship product, Neysa Velocis, is a full-stack AI acceleration platform built for modern AI workloads—from training and fine-tuning to inference. It brings together compute, orchestration, security, and observability to help organizations adopt and scale AI faster, safer, and more efficiently.

**The Opportunity: Build AI Products with Security at the Core**

As a Product Manager – AI & Information Security, you will own and drive product initiatives at the intersection of AI, cloud, and cybersecurity.

You will work closely with engineering, security, design, sales, customer success, and other stakeholders to identify customer problems, define product requirements, prioritize the roadmap, and take products from concept to launch.

This is a hands-on product management role for someone who understands both the opportunities created by AI and the security challenges that come with deploying AI and cloud technologies at scale.

You will be expected to bring strong product thinking along with enough technical depth to work effectively with engineering and security teams, understand complex technology concepts, and translate them into scalable enterprise products.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the product lifecycle from problem discovery and ideation through roadmap, development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Define and maintain the product roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on customer needs, business impact, technical feasibility, and market opportunity.
* Work closely with engineering and security teams to define product requirements, user stories, workflows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Translate complex AI, cloud, and information security concepts into clear product requirements and user experiences.
* Develop a strong understanding of enterprise AI and security use cases through customer conversations, market research, user feedback, and competitive analysis.
* Identify opportunities to build products that address challenges around AI security, cloud security, data protection, identity, access, governance, monitoring, risk, and compliance.
* Partner with engineering throughout the development lifecycle to ensure products are built against the defined customer and business requirements.
* Work with design and engineering teams to create simple, intuitive experiences for complex technical products.
* Collaborate with Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success teams to understand customer requirements and support product adoption.
* Define product positioning, value propositions, and launch requirements in collaboration with GTM teams.
* Track product adoption, usage, customer feedback, and key product metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct competitive analysis across AI platforms, cloud providers, cybersecurity products, and emerging AI security solutions.
* Stay current with developments in GenAI, AI infrastructure, AI security, cloud security, cybersecurity, and enterprise technology and translate relevant trends into product opportunities.
* Work cross-functionally to drive product initiatives from concept to execution, while balancing customer needs, technical constraints, and business priorities.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 4–10 years of experience in Product Management, with demonstrated ownership of technology products.
* Strong experience managing the end-to-end product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements, prioritization, roadmap, development, launch, and iteration.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams on technical or platform products.
* Strong understanding of product discovery, customer research, prioritization frameworks, product metrics, and roadmap management.
* Ability to convert complex customer and business problems into clear product requirements and actionable product roadmaps.
* Strong professional experience working on AI and/or Information Security products is essential.
* Hands-on understanding of AI/ML, GenAI, LLM applications, AI infrastructure, or AI platforms.
* Strong understanding of information security and cybersecurity concepts, with experience translating security requirements into product capabilities.
* Experience with one or more areas such as cloud security, application security, data security, identity and access management, security monitoring, threat detection, governance, risk, compliance, or AI security.
* Understanding of the security challenges associated with AI workloads, cloud environments, APIs, data, models, and enterprise AI adoption.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering, security, and technical teams and understand architectural discussions at a product level.
* Enterprise & Platform Products
* Experience building or managing B2B, enterprise, SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity, AI, or platform products.
* Exposure to products serving technical users, developers, IT teams, security teams, or enterprise customers.
* Experience gathering requirements directly from customers and translating them into product improvements.
* Understanding of enterprise buying journeys, adoption challenges, and technical evaluation processes is preferred.

**Core Competencies**

* AI & GenAI Product Management
* Information Security / Cybersecurity Product Management
* Cloud & Platform Products
* Product Discovery & Customer Research
* Product Strategy & Roadmapping
* Technical Product Management
* Requirements Definition & Prioritization
* Cross-functional Execution
* Customer & Market Understanding
* Product Analytics & Metrics
* Competitive Intelligence
* Enterprise Product Development

**Strategic & Analytical Competencies:**

* Product Thinking: Ability to identify meaningful customer problems, assess opportunities, define the right product solution, and prioritize effectively.
* Technical Depth: Ability to understand AI, cloud, cybersecurity, and platform technologies and collaborate effectively with engineering and security teams.
* Customer-Centricity: Strong ability to engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand pain points and translate them into actionable product opportunities.
* Execution Excellence: Ability to move products from idea → requirements → development → launch → iteration, while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Data-Driven Decision Making: Use product usage, customer feedback, market intelligence, and business metrics to inform product decisions.
* Market & Competitive Understanding: Stay informed about developments across AI, cloud, cybersecurity, AI security, and enterprise technology and identify opportunities for differentiation.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 4–10 years of professional experience in Product Management or closely related product roles.
* Strong experience in AI, cybersecurity / information security, cloud, or related technology products.
* Demonstrated experience taking technology products from concept through development and launch.
* Experience working with engineering and technical teams in an agile product development environment.
* Experience with B2B / enterprise products is preferred.
* Experience in AI security, cloud security, cybersecurity platforms, AI infrastructure, or enterprise AI products will be highly relevant.

**Your Mindset**

* Builder mindset with a genuine interest in AI, cybersecurity, and emerging technology
* Comfortable getting into technical details without losing sight of the customer problem.
* Strong ownership and bias toward execution.
* Curious and comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving technology environment.
* Able to operate effectively in ambiguity and bring structure to complex problems.
* Strong communicator who can influence engineering, security, business, and customer-facing teams.
* Comfortable challenging assumptions and using data and customer insights to make product decisions.

**Team Culture & Inclusion**

* Dynamic, fast-paced, and highly collaborative environment.
* Culture of ownership, transparency, experimentation, and continuous learning.
* Opportunity to work on products at the intersection of AI, cloud, and cybersecurity.
* Diverse and inclusive workplace where every voice is valued.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an experienced Security Engineer to join our Information Security team in Mumbai. In this role, you will help design, build, and maintain solutions that protect HRT’s global infrastructure, systems, and data within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments. You will have the opportunity to build and harness AI tools to solve cutting edge security problems. This is a senior-level, hands-on individual contributor role in cybersecurity, spanning both operations and compliance domains.

From an operational standpoint, you will be responsible for detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, cyber threat intelligence analysis, and adversary emulation exercises for our global infrastructure and systems.

You will also serve as HRT’s Designated Officer in India for applicable regulatory compliance purposes. Approximately 25% of the role will focus on regional regulatory and governance responsibilities, including control assessments, risk management, evidence collection and reporting, and coordination with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders, as well as auditors and regulators. This is not a people management position. We are looking for an experienced engineer who can independently own these responsibilities while remaining deeply involved in hands-on security work.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with global Information Security, Compliance, Legal, and Engineering teams to support applicable regulation and local cybersecurity obligations
* Translate regulatory and security requirements into practical technical controls, implementation guidance, evidence, and reporting
* Assess security controls against applicable regulations and industry-standard frameworks, document risks and gaps, and coordinate remediation with accountable owners
* Build strong cross-functional relationships with HRT’s global teams, auditors, vendors, and other external stakeholders
* Help maintain HRT’s security detection and response program to protect our data and intellectual property from both internal and external threats
* Hunt for, detect, and respond to malicious activity and anomalous events on HRT’s devices and networks
* Conduct cyber threat intelligence research to identify relevant threat actors, and perform adversary emulation and purple teaming exercises
* Investigate security events and support incident response, including any required regional coordination, documentation, and reporting
* Work an on-call rotation on a predefined schedule

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in security engineering
* Experience with red teaming and penetration testing tools and techniques
* Firm grasp of emerging AI security threats and mitigating controls
* Experience using log analysis platforms such as ELK and Splunk
* Experience building, deploying, and supporting automated systems (Python preferred)
* Strong security fundamentals and experience working with Linux systems and command-line tools
* Experience supporting security governance, risk, compliance, or regulatory requirements, preferably within a heavily regulated industry
* Experience collaborating across technical and non-technical teams and communicating clearly with engineers, business stakeholders, auditors, and regulatory stakeholders
* Strong troubleshooting, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to independently drive work from problem definition through implementation
* Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS, and SEBI CSCRF is preferred
* Experience working independently to deliver high-quality completed work

**Culture**

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.
  
  

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.
  
  
Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Please be advised: Use of AI tools by an applicant during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

You can review our Global Applicant Privacy Notice, which explains how we process applicant information.

description:
Position: Cybersecurity GRC Consultant

Location: Mumbai

Duration: Contract to Hire

**Job Description: Cybersecurity GRC Consultant**

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Experience:**
4 years of relevant cybersecurity consulting and audit experience

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

We are seeking a knowledgeable and client-focused
**Cybersecurity GRC Consultant**
to support consulting, assessment, audit, compliance, and documentation engagements across information security, privacy, regulatory compliance, third-party risk, and cyber resilience. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience delivering cybersecurity GRC engagements for clients, interpreting regulatory requirements, conducting maturity and posture assessments, and preparing high-quality client-facing reports, policies, and remediation roadmaps.

Role Overview

The Cybersecurity GRC Consultant will work with clients across industries to assess, design, implement, and improve cybersecurity governance, risk, compliance, privacy, and resilience programs. The role requires strong consulting capability, audit experience, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate technical and regulatory requirements into actionable business controls.

The consultant will contribute to engagements involving ISO standards, NIST-based assessments, Indian financial-sector regulations, privacy compliance, third-party risk management, cyber risk assessment, policy development, awareness programs, and audit readiness.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct cybersecurity GRC consulting, assessment, audit, and advisory engagements for client organizations.
* Perform ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS gap assessments, internal audits, implementation support, risk assessments, control reviews, and certification-readiness activities.
* Support business continuity and resilience engagements aligned with ISO 22301, including BCMS documentation, business impact analysis, risk assessment, continuity planning, and exercise support.
* Conduct cybersecurity posture assessments, maturity assessments, control effectiveness reviews, and compliance gap assessments.
* Assess client environments against relevant frameworks and standards, including:
* ISO/IEC 27001:2022
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework and related NIST guidance
* SOC 2 Type II requirements
* Data Protection and Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA) requirements
* General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
* Data privacy principles, privacy governance, and privacy-by-design requirements
* RBI cybersecurity, IT governance, outsourcing, digital-payment, and related regulatory requirements
* SEBI cybersecurity and cyber-resilience requirements
* IRDAI cybersecurity, information security, and related regulatory requirements
* Lead or support cyber risk management activities, including risk identification, control mapping, risk scoring, treatment planning, risk-register maintenance, and management reporting.
* Conduct Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments, including vendor due diligence, cybersecurity questionnaires, risk evaluation, contractual security requirements, and remediation tracking.
* Support SOC 2 Type II readiness reviews, control design assessments, evidence reviews, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
* Develop, review, and enhance cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, guidelines, frameworks, registers, and process documentation.
* Prepare client deliverables such as assessment reports, audit reports, gap-analysis reports, compliance matrices, risk registers, remediation roadmaps, executive presentations, and management dashboards.
* Conduct cybersecurity awareness and training programs for employees, management, and relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate client workshops, interviews, walkthroughs, evidence reviews, risk discussions, and leadership presentations.
* Track observations, nonconformities, risks, action plans, and closure evidence through the engagement lifecycle.
* Collaborate with technical, legal, privacy, business, audit, and compliance stakeholders to ensure practical implementation of cybersecurity controls.

title: Entra ID SSO Consultant (short-term contract)

White Globe needs SAML single sign-on between our Microsoft 365 tenant and a client's translation platform, so our linguists sign in with White Globe-managed, coded IDs. You will set it up, test it with the client's engineer and hand it over to our in-house administrator.

title: Marine Cargo loss control Specialist surveyors at Mumbai
description:
We’re Hiring \| Marine Loss Control \& Risk Engineering Specialist \| Mumbai
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Marine Loss Control \& Risk Engineering Specialist to strengthen our Marine Cargo Risk Management and Loss Prevention function.
   

 The position requires a professional with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in logistics, cargo handling, marine/transit risk management, loss prevention, root\-cause
   

 analysis and operational gap assessment.
   

  

 The role will focus on proactively identifying why cargo losses occur and how recurrence can be prevented.
   

  

 The specialist will undertake field\-level risk assessments and detailed root\-cause/gap analysis covering exposures such as wet damage, improper handling, shocks \& jolts, inadequate packaging, stowage and stacking failures, compression/load stresses, lashing and securing deficiencies, contamination, cargo characteristics and other logistics\-related causes of loss.
   

  

 A critical part of the role will involve analysing Claims MIS, historical loss trends, survey reports and operational data to identify recurring patterns and loss drivers, correlate field observations with claims experience, and translate the findings into practical and measurable Loss Prevention / Loss Control recommendations for insured clients.
   

  

 The specialist will also support Marine Underwriting by assessing complex or critical cargo exposures prior to risk acceptance, identifying potential loss scenarios and providing technically supported risk insights, warranties, safeguards and loss\-control recommendations to assist underwriting decisions.
   

  

 Preferred Professional Background: Master Mariner / Chief Officer / Second Engineer; or an experienced Engineer / Packaging Specialist with strong practical knowledge of logistics and cargo handling. Candidates from relevant marine, engineering, cargo risk or industrial packaging backgrounds may also be considered where they can demonstrate expertise in packaging design and adequacy, compression/load stresses, palletisation, stacking, stowage planning, lashing, securing and cargo\-handling risk assessment.
   

  

 The successful candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and investigative capability, field presence, technical judgment and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to convert complex observations and loss data into clear gap analyses and actionable recommendations.
   

 The position requires willingness to travel extensively for field risk inspections and client engagements, along with excellent technical report\-writing and presentation skills. Strong proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint is essential for claims analytics, trend analysis and management/client presentations.
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

 Level: Mid\-Senior
   

  

 Experience: Minimum 10 years relevant experience
   

  

 Function: Marine Cargo Risk Management \| Loss Control Engineering \| Loss Prevention \| Risk Engineering
   

 We are looking for a professional who can move beyond conventional inspection and reporting — someone capable of understanding what can go wrong, why losses are occurring, where the control gaps exist, and what engineering interventions can prevent the next loss.

title: Security Researcher
description:
**About Job:** 




 We are looking for a security researcher with strong software engineering skills to help build an AI product for vulnerability discovery and validation. You will turn offensive security knowledge into agent capabilities, tools, and backend workflows that investigate customer and open source systems reliably.
 



  





**What you will build:** 



* Build backend components for agent execution, tool calling, model integration, and structured findings.
* Translate vulnerability research into agent workflows, reusable tools, and source code analysis capabilities.
* Implement controlled tool execution, sandbox isolation, scoped permissions, resource limits, and cleanup.
* Build persistent run state, retries, cancellation, crash recovery, and event streaming.
* Integrate security tools, independent verification, and evidence capture so findings are reproducible.
* Create realistic security scenarios, PoC\-based checks, and regression tests to improve detection quality and reduce false positives.



  





**Engineering experience:** 



* 3\+ years in software engineering, security engineering, or security research, with a track record of building software or security tools.
* Strong TypeScript/Node.js skills and Python experience for tooling, automation, and integrations.
* Experience with APIs, asynchronous systems, databases, automated testing, and debugging complex failures.
* Comfort with Linux, Docker, process/network behavior, and LLM tool calling; clear communication and ownership of components through delivery.



  





**Security knowledge** 



* Bring broad awareness across these layers, with hands\-on depth in at least two areas. Web/API or source code security should be one of your strongest areas.
* Web and APIs: injection, XSS, SSRF, IDOR/BOLA, authorization, tenant isolation, and business\-logic abuse.
* Source code and dependencies: insecure deserialization, memory safety fundamentals, vulnerable libraries, malicious packages, and CVE reproduction.
* AI and LLMs: prompt injection, jailbreaks, unsafe tool use, and MCP trust boundaries.
* Identity and infrastructure: network security, Active Directory, cloud IAM, federation, and privilege escalation.
* Runtime and systems: container, sandbox, and VM isolation; operating\-system permissions, service/library flaws, and kernel attack surfaces.
* Deep kernel research, exploit development, fuzzing, or agent\-framework experience is a plus.



  





**Show us what you have built** 




 Share backend or agent systems, security tools, or open source contributions you have built. Explain what you owned, the security reasoning, design choices, and reliability challenges. CVEs, bug bounties, and research write\-ups provide additional context. A high\-level description is welcome for confidential work.

title: Engineer - Datacenter Operations
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
   

  

****This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office role with a required work\-from\-office presence five days a week.****
**Location:** 
 Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (100% Onsite)
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a proactive Datacenter Operations Engineer with a strong background in operating systems, command\-line management, and mobile/tablet infrastructure. In this role, you will support our Navi Mumbai datacenter and test lab infrastructure, with a primary focus on maintaining Linux, macOS, and mobile device fleets (Android \& iOS) deployed in the environment.
   

  

 Unlike traditional datacenter roles centered on server component replacement, this position heavily emphasizes OS\-level troubleshooting, device provisioning, command\-line operations, network connectivity, and mobile endpoint lifecycle management. You will work onsite in Navi Mumbai while collaborating closely with global engineering teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Linux, macOS \& Mobile Infrastructure Management
* Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain local Linux and macOS endpoints, server environments, and test rigs using command\-line interface (CLI) utilities.
* Manage, provision, and troubleshoot onsite mobile hardware fleets (Android smartphones, tablets, iPads, and iOS test platforms).
* Perform device onboarding, OS flashing/updates, configuration resets, and script\-driven automated deployments across mobile and desktop platforms.
* Diagnose OS\-level connectivity, permission, software installation, and performance issues on mobile devices and workstations.
* Datacenter Operations \& Networking
* Manage physical rack infrastructure, including cabling (copper/fiber), Wi\-Fi Access Points (APs), and Power Distribution Units (PDUs).
* Perform daily environment inspections, monitoring rack temperatures, power draw, Wi\-Fi signal/AP status, and physical port links.
* Maintain structured inventory and tracking for all endpoint hardware, mobile devices, tablets, test bench rigs, and networking gear using asset tagging systems.
* Incident Management \& Documentation
* Track, manage, and resolve Level 2 technical support tickets end\-to\-end within Jira, ensuring compliance with operational SLAs.
* Create and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), system build guides, and infrastructure workflows in Confluence.
* Collaborate with global, cross\-functional engineering teams to escalate platform\-level software/network issues and implement fixes.
* Secondary / As\-Needed Hardware Support
* Provide occasional, low\-frequency assistance with standard rack\-mount hardware rack/stack and basic cabling (heavy server component break\-fix is minimal for this role).
* Escort and supervise external vendors for third\-party facility, ISP, or hardware maintenance.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* Core Requirements
* Communication: Business\-level fluency in spoken and written English, with the ability to clearly articulate technical issues, write concise Jira updates, and collaborate seamlessly with global remote teams.
* Experience: 2–4 years in IT operations, systems administration, or specialized datacenter/lab support roles.
* Operating Systems \& CLI: Strong hands\-on proficiency with Linux (Ubuntu/RHEL/Debian) and macOS, with proven ability to navigate systems, troubleshoot issues, and execute tasks efficiently via Command Line Interface (CLI).
* Mobile Hardware \& Management: Demonstrable experience managing and troubleshooting Android and iOS mobile devices/tablets at scale in an enterprise, testing, or lab setting.
* Networking Basics: Solid understanding of IP networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, Wi\-Fi AP placement/troubleshooting, switching, and physical connectivity.
* Tools \& Process: Direct operational experience using Jira for ticket lifecycle tracking and Confluence for technical documentation.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical troubleshooting skills with a proactive approach to resolving OS and infrastructure issues.
* Preferred / "Nice\-to\-Have" Skills
* Hands\-on scripting experience in Bash, Python, or configuration automation toolsets (e.g., Ansible) for device/system tasks.
* Experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) software (e.g., Jamf, Workspace ONE, Intune).
* Familiarity with enterprise productivity suites like Google Workspace.


**Work Environment \& Physical Demands**
* 100% Onsite: Requires daily on\-premise presence at the Navi Mumbai facility.
* Physical Ability: Comfortable working with rack\-mounted equipment, mobile testing racks, and routine physical cable routing.


**Benefits**
 In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
   

  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents\-in\-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual \& Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life\-event leaves
* Remote\-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote\-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co\-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

title: Senior Process Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Transport Surveillance L3 / SME**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Transport Surveillance and Restoration**
* Monitor and analyze alarms through Assure1, ZDAF, vendor EMS/NMS and Salesforce.
* Perform L3 troubleshooting across DWDM, CWDM, OTN, SDH/SONET, Carrier Ethernet and optical backhaul networks.
* Troubleshoot LOS, LOF, AIS, RDI, OTU/ODU defects, BER/FEC errors, optical\-power degradation, communication failures and repetitive alarms.
* Analyze Rx/Tx power, span loss, OSNR, Q\-factor, BER/FEC, protection status and performance counters.
* Identify whether the fault resides with the network element, fiber span, card/port, OSP, field cabling, power, software or upstream/downstream network.
* Coordinate restoration with Transport Engineering, IP Network, Field Operations, OSP, Event Management and vendor teams.
* Support traffic rerouting, protection switching, circuit grooming, cross\-connect validation and emergency restoration.
* Lead technical troubleshooting during major outages, bridges and war\-room discussions.
* Review noisy nodes, repetitive alarms and Top\-Talker spans and recommend permanent corrective actions.


**TAC and Advanced Technical Support**
* Act as the internal escalation point for complex incidents that cannot be resolved by L1/L2 Transport teams.
* Collect and analyze:
+ Device and system logs
+ Alarm histories
+ Software and firmware versions
+ Card and controller status
+ Configuration differences
+ Crash, process or communication logs

* Identify known software defects, hardware compatibility issues and platform limitations using OEM documentation and release notes.
* Validate software upgrade paths, hardware compatibility, licenses, storage, configuration backups and rollback readiness.
* Recommend software upgrades, patches, configuration changes, card replacement or RMA based on technical findings.
* Support failed software upgrades, partial card upgrades, controller synchronization issues and rollback activities.
* Review and validate MOPs, pre\-checks, post\-checks, rollback plans and maintenance\-window readiness.
* Open and manage technical cases with Ciena, Nokia, Infinera, ADVA/Adtran, Cisco or other OEM TAC teams.
* Provide complete logs, topology details, impact analysis and troubleshooting evidence to OEMs.
* Track vendor TAC cases until a permanent resolution, patch, workaround or hardware replacement is delivered.
* Support testing and validation of vendor\-recommended fixes before implementation in the production network.
* Maintain a knowledge base of known defects, workarounds, upgrade recommendations and recurring platform issues.


**Technical Skills**
**Technologies**
* DWDM, CWDM, OTN, SDH and SONET
* ROADM, WSS, EDFA/Raman amplification
* Transponders, muxponders and optical line systems
* OTU/ODU mapping and Carrier Ethernet services
* Optical power, span loss, OSNR, BER, FEC and Q\-factor
* Protection mechanisms such as 1\+1, SNCP/MSP and OTN/ROADM protection


**Platforms**
 Hands\-on experience with at least two of the following:
   

  

* Ciena 6500, RLS or Waveserver
* Nokia 1830 PSS
* Infinera optical platforms
* ADVA/Adtran FSP 3000 or FSP 150
* Cisco NCS optical platforms


**Tools and Systems**
* Assure1, ZDAF, Netcool or equivalent alarm\-correlation tools
* Salesforce, ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms
* Ciena MCP/OneControl, Nokia NSP/WaveSuite and equivalent vendor EMS/NMS
* Linux/Unix and CLI troubleshooting
* TL1, SNMP, NETCONF or RESTCONF
* Wireshark and log\-analysis tools
* Basic Python, SQL, PowerShell or automation knowledge preferred


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electronics, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, IT or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of Transport/Optical NOC experience for an L3 Engineer.
* 8\+ years for an SME/TAC\-level role.
* Strong experience supporting carrier\-grade telecom or ISP networks.
* Experience handling major incidents, software upgrades, vendor escalations, RCA and field coordination.
* Ability to work independently in a 24x7 rotational environment.


**SME and Leadership Expectations**
* Mentor and coach L1/L2 Transport engineers.
* Review troubleshooting quality, restoration decisions and RCA accuracy.
* Conduct technical training and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Develop SOPs, MOPs, troubleshooting guides and escalation playbooks.
* Present recurring issues, platform risks and improvement plans to management and stakeholders.
* Maintain detailed technical records for future troubleshooting and operational continuity.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Accuracy and timeliness of alarm validation and fault isolation
* Restoration and escalation turnaround time
* Reduction in repetitive and noisy alarms
* Quality of TAC case submissions and vendor follow\-up
* Software\-upgrade and rollback success rate
* RCA and permanent\-fix completion
* Investigation\-backlog reduction
* Technical ticket and documentation quality
* Improvement in L1/L2 capability through coaching
* Reduction in repeat platform, software and hardware incidents


**Ideal Candidate**
 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on
 **L3 Optical Transport Engineer with TAC\-level troubleshooting capability** 
 , able to restore live services, analyze complex software and hardware failures, manage OEM escalations and drive permanent resolution of recurring network issues.

title: GDS Cyber - AI Driven IAM - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\- Senior AI Engineer – IAM \& Cybersecurity**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to support the design and delivery of AI\-led solutions across Identity and Access Management and Cybersecurity domains. This role will help shape how AI capabilities are applied to modern IAM challenges such as identity governance, access management, privileged access, directory services and non\-human identity security.
   

  

 As a senior profile, the candidate will work closely with IAM, Cyber, cloud and business stakeholders to understand client problems, identify practical AI opportunities and convert them into working solutions, prototypes and scalable delivery assets. The focus is not only on technology implementation, but also on improving identity risk visibility, access decisioning, governance efficiency and operational effectiveness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should bring strong hands\-on engineering experience, curiosity to work in the IAM and Cyber domain, and the ability to apply AI, automation and analytics to solve real enterprise identity challenges. While the role requires practical exposure to AI and IAM technologies, the emphasis is on problem solving, consulting mindset, solution ownership and the ability to contribute to enterprise\-scale IAM transformation programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop and operationalize AI solutions for IAM and Cybersecurity use cases across SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, IGA, PAM, AD/Entra ID and NHI domains.
* Build hands\-on AI/ML capabilities using Python, PowerShell, LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, ADKs and AI orchestration engines.
* Develop agentic AI workflows, copilots and automation frameworks for access requests, certification campaigns, provisioning, privileged access, remediation and identity operations.
* Integrate AI solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, Microsoft Graph API, SIEM/SOAR, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike and XDR platforms.
* Analyze identity, access, privilege, vault, directory, activity and security logs to identify risk patterns, anomalies, access recommendations, role mining opportunities and policy gaps.
* Support AI\-driven IAM governance including risk\-based authentication, risk\-based provisioning, access reviews, compliance checks, SOD, identity lifecycle orchestration and audit\-ready reporting.
* Apply ML, classification, optimization, time series analysis, pattern recognition, NLP, UEBA, anomaly detection and predictive risk scoring for identity and access intelligence.
* Work on Non\-Human Identity use cases including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities, token misuse and agent overreach controls.
* Contribute to PAM analytics and automation across CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secret lifecycle management, session monitoring and vault log analytics.
* Create dashboards and insights using Power BI, Tableau and identity analytics views to explain access risk, compliance posture, user activity trends and remediation priorities.
* Collaborate with business, cyber and IAM stakeholders to convert problem statements into working prototypes, scalable solutions and executive\-ready recommendations.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI engineering, software development, data science, automation, cybersecurity analytics or IAM technology delivery.
* Practical experience building AI applications using LLM/SLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agentic AI, AI agents, copilots and multi\-agent workflows.
* Strong programming and automation experience in Python, PowerShell, APIs, SQL basics and Microsoft Graph API; exposure to HTML, CSS and JavaScript is preferred.
* Hands\-on exposure to Azure AI, OpenAI, AWS, Python\-based AI/ML frameworks, ML models, classification, optimization, NLP, pattern recognition, time series analysis and anomaly detection.
* Working knowledge of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, SAML, OAuth, OIDC with PKCE, authentication, authorization, federation, certificate management and key management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Directory Services, DNS, Global Catalog, GPO, OU, Domains/Forests, FSMO roles and Sites and Services.
* Experience or strong exposure to IGA platforms and concepts such as SailPoint, Saviynt, identity lifecycle, access reviews, certification campaigns, role mining, SOD, access risk and policy compliance.
* Experience or strong exposure to PAM concepts and tools including CyberArk, Privilege Cloud, EPM, EPV, CPM, PSM, JIT/JEA, password rotation, secrets, session monitoring and vault logs.
* Understanding of NHI and AI identity security including service accounts, managed identities, service principals, enterprise applications, API\-based identities, workload identities, agent identities and token controls.
* Experience with security monitoring or analytics platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, XDR and Identity Protection.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to communicate AI, IAM and Cybersecurity topics clearly to technical teams and leadership stakeholders.


**Nice to have**
* Experience identifying AI use cases for IAM transformation, identity analytics, access recommendations, privileged access recommendations, NHI governance and automated remediation.
* Experience with data pipelines, identity and privilege analytics pipelines, model monitoring, observability, MLOps and scalable deployment of enterprise AI solutions.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, dashboards and data storytelling for access risk, compliance posture and identity operations.
* Exposure to SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, CISSP, CISM, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Azure AI or Google ML certifications is preferred.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services or large enterprise environment is a plus.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. description:

In addition to operational maintenance, this role actively validates, audits, and assesses technical controls to ensure privileged accounts adhere to strict zero\-trust and least\-privilege standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Implementation \& Support (L2 Operations)** 



* Handle Day\-2 operations, ticket escalations, and incident resolution for PAM components (Safe management, account onboarding, CPM/PSM failures, and policy errors).

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

 Hands\-on experience with at least one enterprise PAM tool (CyberArk PAS/Privilege Cloud, BeyondTrust Password Safe, Delinea/Thycotic) and Cloud PIM (Microsoft Entra ID PIM).

 Working knowledge of Windows Server (Active Directory, Kerberos, GPOs), Linux/Unix (SSH, PAM modules, sudoers), and networking fundamentals (firewall ports, DNS, RDP, SSH).

 Basic PowerShell, Bash, or Python scripting skills to assist with automated onboarding, discovery parsing, and API calls.

 Solid understanding of Least Privilege, Zero Trust, MFA, Session Isolation, and Break\-Glass procedures.

* CyberArk Defender (PAM\-DEF) or Sentry (PAM\-SEN)
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\)

 Own TRYST’s IT infrastructure and day\-to\-day IT operations — identity and endpoint operations on Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, TRYST cloud and overlay connectivity, devices, backups, and first\-line service.
 



 Build the function from a standing start: standards, vendors, assets and the first hires. Do the work yourself until there is a team. Coordinate campus network, licensed software and journal access with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre rather than recreating those services. Grow the role into Head of Infrastructure as TRYST scales.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 Note : It's an Individual Contributor role initially and based on Org. requirements , the team can be aligned later.
 



**Infrastructure, cloud and campus overlay** 



* Design, implement and operate TRYST\-owned infrastructure: Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, the endpoint estate, file and backup services, TRYST cloud (Azure as the starting tenancy), and overlay connectivity on the campus network.
* Partner with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre on campus LAN/Wi\-Fi, research computing, and software / journal catalogues. Own the TRYST overlay, the join path for a new employee, and the escalation path to Computing Centre.
* Set infrastructure standards and runbooks that will still hold as TRYST grows across Centres and toward 1,000\+ people, on a common identity and device baseline.
* Plan capacity, backup and disaster recovery for TRYST\-owned systems. Campus backbone DR remains with Computing Centre.



**Identity, endpoint and security operations** 



* Operate Microsoft 365 / Entra ID as TRYST’s directory: account hygiene, groups, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and the joiner / mover / leaver path from the HR system (Keka).
* Own endpoint management and protection (Intune or equivalent, disk encryption, patching and baseline hardening). TRYST handles research IP; unmanaged devices are not the default.
* Own infrastructure security for TRYST\-run systems: access, backups, incident first\-response, and the first set of IT security policies with the CEO.
* Keep security usable. Default access should follow the employee’s role; exceptions should be the minority.



**Service delivery** 



* Provide IT support until a dedicated service desk exists: provisioning, workstation and access issues, with a published response target.
* Establish a single, simple request channel and evolve it as headcount grows.
* Support lab, compute and connectivity needs of research Centres, escalating specialised research computing to Computing Centre or an agreed cloud pattern.



**Vendors, assets and budget** 



* Own vendor relationships for devices, connectivity overlays, cloud, endpoint security and any managed\-service overflow.
* Maintain the IT asset register and lifecycle — issue, recover, wipe and recycle — tied to joining and leaving.
* Manage the infrastructure and endpoint budget and provide actuals for TRYST IT cost planning.



**Team and operating model** 



* Hire, coach and oversee the first support and infrastructure engineers as workload justifies it.
* Clarify ownership between TRYST IT, HR, Finance and Computing Centre, including where a service is TRYST\-owned, outsourced, or provided by IIT Bombay.
* Leave the organisation able to add a Head of IT, an applications lead and a security lead as TRYST scales, without rewiring this job.



**EXPERIENCE** 




**Required** 




 8–12 years in IT infrastructure, systems, network or workplace/endpoint engineering, with end\-to\-end ownership rather than ticket\-only support.
 



 • Hands\-on with cloud identity and modern workplace (Microsoft 365 / Entra ID or a close equivalent): directory, MFA and device management — not only on\-premises Active Directory.
 



 • Experience designing and operating network, server/cloud and backup/disaster\-recovery environments.
 



 • Vendor, contract and budget management. Experience hiring or coaching at least one engineer.
 



 • Comfortable remaining hands\-on — imaging a laptop, resolving connectivity issues, supporting a joiner — as well as designing the environment.
 



**Preferred** 




 Built infrastructure for a growing organisation rather than only running a mature one.
 



 • Campus, academic, research\-lab or institutional environments, especially coordinating with a central computing or network group you do not control.
 



 • Identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver) with an HR system such as Keka.
 



 • Familiarity with Indian vendor and procurement practice, and with Mumbai / IIT campus context.
 



  





**WHAT WE LOOK FOR** 



* High tolerance for ambiguity: standards will be written here, not inherited.
* Judgement that balances security, reliability and pace — research IP on one side, an early\-stage timetable on the other.
* Credibility with scientists, operators and vendors, and the ability to hold a single TRYST IT stack rather than parallel Centre\-level ones.
* A bias to hands\-on execution in the first year, with the systems thinking so the second year is not a rewrite.



  





**REMUNERATION** 




**Level** 




 Manager.
 



**Compensation** 




 Competitive and commensurate with experience

title: Problem Manager
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Problem Manager
   

  


**Location:** 
 India, Mumbai
   

  





 The Agfa\-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business\-to\-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. The Agfa\-Gevaert Group strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by delivering innovative technology, high\-quality solutions, and sustainable business practices. Agfa’s headquarters and parent company are located in Mortsel, Belgium.
   

  





**About the Role** 




 Agfa is looking for an experienced
 **Problem Manager** 
 to join its Global ICS (Information \& Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end Problem Management process across a complex ecosystem of internal IT teams, managed service providers, and strategic technology partners. Your primary objective will be to identify, analyze, and eliminate the root causes of recurring incidents, thereby improving service stability and enhancing the overall user experience.
 



 As a key member of the IT Service Management organization, you will facilitate root cause investigations, and ensure that sustainable corrective actions are implemented. You will play a critical role in reducing operational risk, improving service performance, and driving continuous improvement across Agfa's global IT landscape.
 



**About You (Skills Required)** 




 You are a proactive and analytical professional who enjoys solving complex operational challenges and driving service improvements. You excel at working with diverse stakeholders, influencing teams without direct authority, and coordinating efforts across multiple service providers.
 



 You possess:
 


* Strong analytical and root cause investigation capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* A structured and process\-oriented approach to service management.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on operational excellence and service stability.



**What You'll Do (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Lead and continuously improve the global Problem Management process.
* Coordinate problem investigations across internal teams, service providers, and technology partners.
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) activities for recurring and major incidents.
* Ensure the identification, tracking, and implementation of permanent corrective actions.
* Facilitate collaboration between technical teams to resolve complex and cross\-functional problems.
* Provide regular status updates and reporting to business stakeholders and leadership.
* Manage escalations related to problem investigations and resolution activities.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and identify opportunities for continuous service improvement.
* Perform trend analysis, reporting, and metrics tracking to proactively identify improvement opportunities.
* Act as backup for the Incident Manager when required.



**What You'll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven track record in Problem Management roles.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL Problem Management processes and best practices.
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher certification is preferred.
* Experience working in SIAM (Service Integration and Management) and multi\-supplier environments.
* Understanding of service integration, governance, and operational reporting.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional technical teams in large\-scale IT environments.
* Strong analytical skills with proven experience conducting Root Cause Analysis and driving permanent resolutions.
* Excellent stakeholder, communication, and vendor management capabilities.
* High degree of flexibility and willingness to support critical problem investigations and major incident follow\-up activities outside standard business hours when required in a global environment.



**Why Join Us** 



* Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a major digital transformation initiative.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long\-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization focused on operational excellence and service quality.
* Collaborate with international teams, strategic technology partners, and business stakeholders worldwide.
* Play a key role in improving service stability and preventing recurring business\-impacting issues across Agfa's global IT environment.



 If you are passionate about root cause analysis, continuous improvement, and driving sustainable service excellence in a complex global IT landscape, we invite you to join Agfa and help shape the future of our IT services.

title: Configuration Manager
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Configuration Manager
 
  
 



**Location:** 
 India, Mumbai
 



  
 



 The Agfa\-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business\-to\-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. The Agfa\-Gevaert Group strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by delivering innovative technology, high\-quality solutions, and sustainable business practices. Agfa’s headquarters and parent company are located in Mortsel, Belgium.
 


  About the Role
 
 Agfa is seeking a
 **Configuration Manager** 
 to join its Global ICS (Information \& Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and governance of configuration and asset information across Agfa's global IT environment. You will own the Configuration Management process and ensure that the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) accurately reflects the current state of IT services, infrastructure, applications, and assets throughout their lifecycle.
 



 As a key member of the IT Service Management organization, you will support critical IT processes including Change Management, Incident Management, Problem Management, Asset Management, and Risk Management. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, business units, service providers, and technology partners to ensure reliable data, effective governance, and operational excellence.
 


  About You (Skills Required)
 
 You are highly organized, detail\-oriented, and passionate about data quality and governance. You enjoy collaborating with multiple stakeholders, improving processes, and creating transparency across complex IT environments.
 



 You possess:
 


* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strong coordination and organizational skills.
* A structured and process\-driven mindset.
* Strong understanding of data quality, governance, and compliance principles.
* A proactive approach to continuous improvement and operational excellence.


  What You'll Do (Duties \& Responsibilities)
 * Own and continuously improve the Configuration Management process.
* Ensure Configuration Item (CI) records remain accurate, complete, and up to date throughout their lifecycle.
* Manage, maintain, and enhance the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), including data structures, standards, and governance controls.
* Support Change Management by ensuring configuration data is available, accurate, and aligned with approved changes.
* Conduct configuration audits and verification activities to ensure compliance and data accuracy.
* Monitor and improve data integrity and quality across configuration and asset records.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, business units, vendors, and service providers to maintain accurate configuration information.
* Validate and reconcile managed Configuration Items with Agfa business units.
* Ensure timely tracking and return of leased devices to leasing companies.
* Produce governance reports, metrics, and compliance reporting related to configuration and asset management.
* Manage configuration\-related escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Act as backup for the Change Manager when required.


  What You'll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)
 * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
* Proven experience in Configuration Management, Asset Management, IT Service Management, or IT Operations.
* Strong understanding of Configuration Management principles, CMDB governance, and IT asset lifecycle management.
* Experience working with CMDB platforms and asset management solutions.
* Solid understanding of IT Service Management processes, including Change, Incident, and Problem Management.
* Experience working in outsourced IT environments and collaborating with external service providers.
* Strong reporting, data governance, and process management skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
* ITIL Foundation certification or comparable IT Service Management certification is considered an asset.


  Why Join Us
 * Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to digital transformation initiatives.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long\-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization that underpins business\-critical operations worldwide.
* Collaborate with international teams, service providers, and technology partners.
* Play a key role in improving data quality, governance, and operational stability across Agfa's global IT landscape.
* Help build a reliable and transparent IT environment that enables effective service delivery and informed decision\-making.



  
 



 If you are passionate about Configuration Management, governance, data integrity, and continuous improvement, and you enjoy working in a global IT environment, we invite you to join Agfa and contribute to the reliability and effectiveness of our worldwide IT services.

* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Make a meaningful impact on how AI handles real\-world cybersecurity challenges
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Information Security Manager
description:
**Location : Mumbai** 




**Designation :** 
 Information Security Manager
 



  





**About the role** 




 We're looking for someone to build BitDelta's information security function from the ground up — and stay hands\-on while doing it.
 



  





 This isn't a role where you'll inherit a team and a playbook. You'll create both. You'll design the security architecture that protects our live trading platform, run our penetration testing and red\-team work, keep us compliant with the regulators who matter, oversee our SOC and incident response, and act as our Data Protection Officer.
 



  





 It's a builder's job, and a technical one. We care most about strong security fundamentals. If you know crypto and blockchain, great — but you don't need to be an expert on day one. A solid high\-level understanding is enough, and we'll teach you the rest. What we can't teach is a security\-first instinct.
 



  





**What you'll actually do** 




**Security architecture and operations** 




 You'll own the whole security picture — the exchange app, the APIs, and everything underneath. That means driving application security and secure development practices, staying on top of vulnerabilities as they surface, and hardening endpoints across our Mumbai offices. You'll run our 24x7 SOC monitoring, write the runbooks and escalation paths, and lead incidents from the first alert through to the post\-mortem.
 



  





**Offensive security** 




 You'll plan and run penetration tests across the application, network, and infrastructure — including the live platform. You'll work with both internal and external red teams, think like an attacker to find gaps before anyone else does, and design phishing simulations and social engineering tests to keep everyone sharp. Then you'll chase every finding through to a fix.
 



  





**Governance, risk, and compliance** 




 You'll own our security governance — the policies, standards, and controls, aligned to ISO 27001, NIST, and general good practice. You'll handle regulatory queries from FIU\-IND, CERT\-In, and others, make sure our controls stay audit\-ready, and support internal and external audits and risk assessments.
 



  





**Data protection** 




 As our DPO under India's DPDP Act 2023, you'll represent BitDelta on data\-protection matters with regulators. You'll get to know our data deeply — how it moves, where it lives, who can touch it — and own classification, lifecycle management, privacy controls, DPIAs, and breach notifications.
 



  





**Vendors and third parties** 




 You'll manage our security service providers: setting clear SLAs, holding people to them, checking vendor security posture, and reviewing the security terms in contracts.
 



  





**Building the team** 




 You'll hire, structure, and mentor a security team from scratch — defining roles and growth paths, setting up processes and tooling that scale, and working closely with engineering, infrastructure, compliance, and operations.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* Around 7–10 years in information security, with real technical depth — not just management experience.
* Strong hands\-on grounding in infrastructure, network, application, and cloud security.
* Genuine penetration testing experience, comfortable with tools like Burp Suite, Nmap, and Metasploit.
* Solid GRC and regulatory background, ideally in fintech, BFSI, or another regulated space.
* Experience running or overseeing SOC/SIEM operations and incident response.
* Working knowledge of data protection principles and India's DPDP Act.
* A track record of building teams and processes from nothing.
* Clear communication — you can hold your own with regulators, auditors, and senior leadership



  





**Nice to have** 




 Certifications like CISSP, CISM, OSCP, CEH, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer. Exposure to crypto, blockchain, or VDA platforms — or a real eagerness to learn.
 



 A background in fintech, exchanges, or BFSI.
 



 Prior DPO or privacy experience.

**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace Migration** 




 • Plan and execute the migration of email, calendars, contacts, files, shared drives, user accounts, groups, permissions, and related services from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace.
 



 • Prepare migration plans, user mapping, data validation, rollback and cutover procedures while ensuring data integrity, security, compliance, and minimal business disruption.

**2\. Google Workspace Administration \& Security** 




 • Administer users, organizational units, groups, domains, shared drives, licences, administrative roles, Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Meet, Groups, and Google Vault.
 



 • Configure MFA, SSO, access controls, external\-sharing restrictions, retention policies, email protection, security alerts, investigation rules, audit logging, eDiscovery, and legal holds.

**3\.** 
**Endpoint Management \& Endpoint Security** 




 • Manage the lifecycle of Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS devices, including enrolment, configuration, patching, application deployment, inventory, compliance monitoring, and secure decommissioning.

**4\. Security Operations, DLP \& Incident Response** 




 •Conduct security\-posture assessments, review policies and configurations, track identified risks and remediation actions and implement practical enhancements with internal teams and security partners.

**5\. VAPT, ISO 27001 \& Compliance** 




 •Coordinate VAPT scope, access, schedules, rules of engagement, evidence, remediation, retesting, and closure with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
 



 •Maintain vulnerability registers and support ongoing remediation across endpoints, networks, servers, cloud platforms, and applications.
 



 •Support ISO 27001, internal, customer, and regulatory audits by coordinating evidence, control testing, risk assessments, non\-conformities, corrective actions, and compliance documentation.
 



  





**6\. IT Infrastructure, VDI \& Vendor Management** 




 •Support secure and reliable office networks, internet connectivity, servers, storage, backups, recovery readiness, and related infrastructure upgrades or office migrations.
 



 •Evaluate VDI and other secure\-access solutions for remote work and BYOD, covering identity, data protection, device isolation, performance, scalability, and user experience.
 



 •Coordinate service providers and technology vendors for evaluation, procurement, implementation, maintenance, escalations, and proofs of concept.
 



  





**7\. Operations, Documentation \& Collaboration** 




 •Resolve escalated IT infrastructure and information security issues and collaborate with business teams, management, auditors, and vendors on technical and security requirements.
 



 •Maintain policies, SOPs, infrastructure diagrams, inventories, configuration records, troubleshooting guides, handover documents, licences, and operational reports.
 



 •Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions that improve security, scalability, reliability, operational efficiency, and user experience.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 




 •Over 4 Years \+ Hands\-on experience in information security, IT infrastructure, endpoint administration, or a comparable role
 



 •Strong Google Workspace administration and security expertise, including Admin Console, Gmail, Drive, Shared Drives, Vault, endpoint management, access controls, and audit capabilities.
 



 •Experience with Microsoft 365\-to\-Google Workspace migrations and working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Microsoft security controls.
 



 •Practical knowledge of MDM/UEM, EDR, patching, device compliance, IAM, MFA, SSO, RBAC, DLP, incident response, VAPT, vulnerability management, and ISO 27001\.
 



 •Working understanding of networks, firewalls, VPNs, servers, storage, backups, cloud services, and business\-continuity requirements.
 



 •Strong troubleshooting, documentation, stakeholder\-management, vendor\-coordination, and project\-execution skills.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications**

The role also supports the integration of EdgeConneX security and customer security efforts, ensuring compliance with all applicable standards. * Superb ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and responsibilities simultaneously.
* Disciplined execution: tracking, documentation, follow\-through, and closure.
* Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders in a multilingual Indian environment without losing attention to detail.
* Commitment to organizational excellence and constant awareness of opportunities to improve processes and quality of deliverables.
* Superb ability to work independently while adhering to standards.
* Ability to use computer systems related to security management and reporting.


**Experience / Education**

* Minimum 2 of those years managing large\-scale security design and installation projects.
* Experience supporting critical infrastructure environments; Data center experience strongly preferred.
* Experience delivering in India or the broader APAC region, including working knowledge of local construction practices and jurisdictional security requirements.

It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies. You will also team up with our global professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance. You will be leveraging emerging technologies like AI, ML, to build and enhance new solutions and actively work in building multiple tools and assets for efficient and effective client delivery. By plugging into our market\-leading global network, you'll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional IT Risk Advisor.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Consistently deliver quality client services. Drive high\-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget. Monitor progress manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
* Foster relationships with client personnel to analyse, evaluate, and enhance information systems to develop and improve security at procedural and technology levels.
* Use knowledge of the current IT environment and industry trends to identify engagement and client service issues and communicate this information to the engagement team and client management through written correspondence and verbal presentations. Stay abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business.
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Demonstrate ability to quickly assimilate to new knowledge.
* Partnering with onshore teams to understand client’s business \& related industry issues / trends for global clients.
* Contribute to new solution development basis the industry trends and client’s problem statement.
* Conduct knowledge sharing discussions \& contribute to EY thought leadership.
* Understanding our clients’ overall technology strategy to effectively manage risk while transforming their business.
* Manage day\-to\-day client relationships, leading client meetings, working sessions, and status reporting.
* Stay up to date with emerging industry trends and technologies, suggest innovative solutions to engagement teams and provide recommendations to clients on potential risks and opportunities.
* Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Knowledge of IT risk, information security frameworks such as COSO, COBIT etc.
* IT Risk and Controls assessment with exposure of any of the technologies such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, MS Dynamics or emerging technologies such as Cloud, RPA, AI/ML
* Cognitive problem\-solving capabilities, quick decision\-making skills and ability to handle complex situations with a calm demeanour.
* Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
* Effective organization and time management skills with the ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines.
* Team player with strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to think differently and innovate


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Chartered accountant (CA) or Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Management, Information Systems/ Technology, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
* Passion for technology and an ardent desire to work in risk management.
* Approximately 3\-6 years of related work experience in Risks \& Controls, IT Risk Management, IT Audit.


**Additionally, Good To Have**
* Proven experience in direct client facing roles, collaborate with cross functional teams including internal audits, IT security and business stakeholders to assess control effectiveness and facilitate remediation activities.
* Good to have relevant industry certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant).


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Prior Big 4 or consulting leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success in market development or sector focused propositions.
* Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
* Coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.
